Title: DevWorldRed Kill Withered at Farm
Description: Travel to DevWorld Farm and eliminate some Withered.
Objective Proposal Response: Greetings, fresh meat. Why don't you go to DevWorld Farm and take out some Withered. If you come back in one piece, your status might be upgraded from fresh meat to rare meat.
In Progress Response: DevWorld Farm is a dangerous place, I understand if fresh meat like you can't handle it
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah yes, you have returned... in one piece, no less... I hearby bestow upon you the title of "rare meat". Congratulations. Now go talk to the artificer to rise one more rank on the meat scale.

Title: DevWorldRed Get Loot at Farm
Description: Search DevWorld Farm and bring back anything you find.
Objective Proposal Response: Greetings, rare meat. You are probably tired of being called that, so I will help you if you help me. I might be able to elevate your status to medium-well meat if you score me some loot from DevWorld Farm.
In Progress Response: I'm losing patience, and you don't want me to lose my patience. Hurry up and get me that loot.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah I see you have arrived with my loot. I hereby bestow upon you the title of "medium-well meat". You ain't to bad, kid.

Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_apologizesmall" />I'm sorry to dash your friend's dreams of wealth, <g id="female_nodyes" />but she should know, it's quite impossible to leave the island. <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />The stormwall is… a force of nature.

Title: Verdant Restoration
Description: Climb Mirador Shrine, complete the ancient puzzle, restore the gemstone, then speak with Nessa.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_waghand01" />Oh no! I promise you! I'm not just saying this so you'll help. <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />I think you'll agree, the situation is a bit desperate here, and you are capable.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />If that Gemstone isn't restored soon, I'm afraid the situation could get even worse.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />Well met, newcomer. It's rare to see someone who's just arrived become such a pivotal figure in Corinth, but <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Nessa speaks very highly of you.

Title: Hidden Power
Description: Explore the Oracle Therismos to find the Ancient Map leading to the other Verdant Gemstones.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Mostly just how little we truly know.<g id="litearmor_willcoverit" /> I've dedicated several lifetimes to studying Aeternum's history, but much of it remains a mystery.
In Progress Response: <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />We're very fortunate you came to Aeternum when you did. <g id="litearmor_headtilthmm" />I have a feeling historians of the future will be studying records of your feats.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />Excellent! I'm afraid we've not had much luck with these scrolls, <g id="female_takeItem8s" priority="high"/>but let's see what you brought back… ooh, yes this is clearly some sort of map.

Title: The Speaker's Crimes
Description: Join Saatvik and Leovix in the Town Hall to confront the Speaker of the Winds with proof of his crimes.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />After you left, frustrations boiled over. Elder Saatvik insisted they wait for your return, <g id="female_nodyes" />but Leovix was quite past the point of reason.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_nodyes" />I do hope you can resolve the situation with the Speaker peacefully and quickly. We have much work to do.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />So the Speaker himself had the second gemstone. How did I not see that coming?

Title: Verdant Connections
Description: Return the Verdant Gemstone to Eldergate by climbing to the top of the ruins.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_nodding" />That does seem to be the next logical step, so you have my support. <g id="female_spreadarms" />We'll continue with the map. The shrine is to the <g id="female_pointRight" />southwest of the city.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Is that something new I hear on the wind? I believe it's the sound of… <g id="male_nodunderstand" />yes, it's the sound of procrastination!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="grace_welcome" />Well, look at you, breathing life back into this wee, sad town. <g id="grace_headnodyes" />You almost make me want to pitch in.

Title: Jewel of the Sea
Description: Talk to Nessa near the Pirate Den known as Hecker's Haven. Then enter the Den and challenge Captain Korrapati to recover the third Verdant Gemstone.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="grace_convince1" />You've got it covered. And I’m starting to grow moss on my backside.
In Progress Response: <g id="grace_goaway" />Go on, then! You better not be getting sentimental on me.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_spreadarms" />Splendid! You clearly weren't eaten by the alligator. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />And you don't even have any rips on your clothes.

Title: The Spirit Returns
Description: Return the third Verdant Gemstone to Sirius and solve the ancient puzzle.
Player Prompt: "Just glad this is the last one."
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Agreed! While you head to Sirius, <g id="male_willcoverit" />I'll visit town and make sure preparations are under way to resume the tribute.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />It's very exciting, isn't it? <g id="female_spreadarms" />Once we've restored the jewel at Sirius, things will get better. You'll see.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />Well, so much for my theory that Medea would be understanding, <g id="male_explain" />but of course… keep in mind, she doesn't have all the facts.

Title: The Path of Thorns
Description: Infiltrate Thornhall, the most holy site of Windsward's druids, and find Medea. Convince her to give the region a second chance.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Well, we have to at least try, don't we? <g id="male_handheart" />Or perhaps as the last druid, I should be volunteering as tribute. <g id="male_shakehead" />Can't say I'm too excited about that.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_worry" />Though I'm extremely nervous about encountering Medea, I have to confess, I'm also a bit excited to finally meet her.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="grace_spreadarms" />Behold, the gifted warrior who bested me approaches. <g id="grace_convince" />I am sorely tempted to test you once again, <g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />but your friend Nessa has now shared the whole story.

Description: Travel north to Fisherman's Bend to find the Old Man that Medea believes can help expel the Corruption from your mind.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="grace_sorry" />There is a much greater battle brewing, one I can take no part in. But you… <g id="grace_convince1" />you are destined to play a role in it, for good or for evil.
In Progress Response: <g id="grace_shrugDontcare" />There is nothing more for either of us here. Our destinies lie elsewhere, but we may cross paths again.

Title: Brushed by Fate
Description: Return Fude Hinode's set of brushes to her from where she left them at Eldergate.
Player Prompt: "Looks like there's a label on them."
Objective Proposal Response: [If found, please return to the tavern in Corinth - signed F. Hinode.]
In Progress Response: [The brushes are unlikely to make it back to the settlement without your help.]
Destination Completion Available Respons: My brushes! Thank you, thank you! I’ve painted so many places I forgot where I left them.

Title: Seeds of Steel
Description: Find and read the creed of the Iron Rose.
Objective Proposal Response: To join the Iron Rose Company. Stalwart bastions of valor they are. I don't have a copy of the creed.
In Progress Response: I know all the Iron Rose mercenaries. Commander Merrill, Captain Leovix Silva, Cotheran the Red, Gideon Sturm!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You're back! I had heard that many of them became Lost. I was worried about you.

Title: A Garden of Iron
Description: Obtain an Iron Rose Sword for Roya.
Objective Proposal Response: I agree. Problem is, I don't have a sword. And Iron Rose soldiers ought to have an Iron Rose blade.
In Progress Response: I hear Iron Rose swords are weighted differently than most. Their center of gravity is oddly located, increasing thrusting power.
Destination Completion Available Respons: A warrior is no more noble or sharp than the iron of the blade he carries. No more graceful than the way he treats others.

Title: By Any Other Name
Description: Deliver Roya's application to the missing mercenary.
Objective Proposal Response: I wrote an application letter and took it to Captain Silva. But he's head of the townsguard now.
In Progress Response: Thank you for all you have done for me. Perhaps it's time I embrace the path of all great bakers like… uh… I can't think of any to be honest with you.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Darkness. Death. A baleful curse. That's all that is left of our order. Company of Lies and Ashes is more like it.

Title: Supply Run
Description: Craft tools, then gather and refine the materials requested by Talesa Serrano.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />Tell that to the annual tribute. <g id="sit_gestureleftM" />That last collection was a kick in the nethers.
In Progress Response: <g id="sit_headshakeno" />Our stores are as barren as a gravedigger's prospects.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hey, look at this! <g id="sit_nod" />Something approaching an actual stockpile, I haven't seen that in months!

Title: Fire Up the Forge
Description: Craft an Iron Longsword at the Forge and bring it to Mason Zhang Haoyu in Corinth when you have completed your task.
Objective Proposal Response: There's trouble with the tribute? I hadn't heard that. I was talking about the Lost overrunning the farms.
In Progress Response: Open the satchel of ore I gave you, smelt it, then hammer out an iron sword.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Now, let's see your handiwork… impressive. Quite impressive. Either you've done this before, or you've got a knack for it.

Title: A Town in Need
Description: Check the Corinth Town Board to discover more ways to help Corinth prosper
Objective Proposal Response: 06A_TS_03_LearnTownBoard_proposal
In Progress Response: 06A_TS_03_LearnTownBoard_incomplete
Destination Completion Available Respons: 06A_TS_03_LearnTownBoard_response

Title: Just Dessert
Description: Travel to Sweet Acre Farm to recover Kathrijn's Blueberry Compote and harvest Strawberries, Blueberries, Squash or Corn.
Objective Proposal Response: No, dessert! Who could turn down some tasty treats?
In Progress Response: Those strawberries are going to go bad if you don't get to them soon! And who could resist some homemade blueberry compote!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You did it! You got the desserts! Oh, there will be a feast in Corinth tonight, I tell you! But first, how about we try a little here?

Title: Pirates of Spice
Description: Travel to the area around Buccaneer Creek and Mother's Tears to locate the missing spices.
Objective Proposal Response: I'm going to help make it! But first, I need something those pirates stole from me.
In Progress Response: I need my saffron, pepper, and cardamom from the pirates at Mother’s Tears.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Sweet success! I can smell those spices from here! The fiery peppers, the rich scent of saffron, the warming aroma of cardamom.

Title: The Bear of Scratchrock
Description: Hunt Pumas in the area and bring down the bear of Scratchrock Burrow. Report back to Tsui Fen when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />You look tough enough to help hunt pumas. They provide good food for the settlement, and hides for the tanner's guild.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_shakehead" />This bear is unnaturally savage. It has plenty of natural prey, so it shouldn't keep mauling passersby.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_takeItem8s" />Wonderful! This will make a pleasant change from all the wolf meat we've been eating. A little variety is good for morale.

Title: Shot Across the Bow
Description: Sabotage cannons and light striped powderkegs on fire at the pirate stronghold. Defeat Shamgar then return to Michael Lewis.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_youknow" />You know how the Swarmancers destroyed the farm? Ruined the windmills? Made it hard to get anything done?
In Progress Response: Damn pirates, think they can go around raiding decent folk with impunity. Let's see how they like having their homes raided.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />That'll teach them! I could see those explosions from here! With any luck, that will bring us a spell of peace from the pirates.

Title: Warp and Weft
Description: Collect Loom Patterns and Fabric Samples from Sirius and Stoneview Seabreak.
Objective Proposal Response: Oh let me tell you. Crafting takes time, and my method would be a bit faster.
In Progress Response: Every second you stay here is another thread frayed, another shirt torn, another cloth dirtied.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh. My thanks! How utterly divine! Look at this cloth! It has withstood the centuries and yet looks freshly made.

Title: Zoology 101
Description: Margot is researching strange things in Aeternum. She wants to know why there are Buffalo here. Investigate the area and gather samples and any notes you find regarding them.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_nodyes" /> They are a species from a completely different part of the world from all others on Aeternum. There must be a reason.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_thinking" />Haven't discovered anything yet? That's okay. Take your time. The wonders of the world unfurl slowly in our fragile hands.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" />What have you uncovered about our furry friends?

Title: A Wyrd and Wonderful World
Description: Margot has discovered a plant that seems to have strange properties. Gather sprigs of it and present them to people around Windsward to see what their reactions are.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />More people around here would be if they glimpsed the glory of Wyrdwood trees. Their beauty is trascendent.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_shrugBrief" />Wonder is a clandestine thing. It seldom shows its face to those who are in a hurry.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I see smiles on faces that were once dour because of you. To know that even one person breathes easier because of us is to have suceeded.

Title: This Mortal Sphere
Description: A group of archeologists have gone missing near an ancient tomb. Follow their trail and discover what has happened then report back to Elric Chapman.
Objective Proposal Response: Pardon me, I was mostly thinking aloud. Just north of here there's an ancient tomb with strange spheres around it.
In Progress Response: No luck yet? Oh dear. Could be they are lost to time - just like my mother's affection. Buried under sand and dust…
Destination Completion Available Respons: You've survived! I was beginning to worry. What did you find?

Title: Creation Myths
Description: Elric has some interesting theories about the spheres. Follow his instructions and set them in place. Then report your findings back to him.
Objective Proposal Response: The spheres seem to store power. I believe that if you infuse them with enough azoth, they should be able to interact with other spheres nearby.
In Progress Response: We'll discover the secrets of the Ancients, you and I. That'll prove my worth. Maybe then my mother will say something nice to me.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You've returned! Were you able to get a reaction from the spheres?

Title: Towering Tools
Description: Collect any remaining tools of the Ancients from Fallswatch Overlook and Mirador, then return to Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
Objective Proposal Response: Oh, well, I am an Antiquarian. Yelena Pajitnova. Nice to... meet you.
In Progress Response: This view is magnificent, isn't it? How they built such wonders is beyond me. If you'll recover any tools you can find, I might have a better idea.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have a gleam in your eye... you've found something? Let me see!

Title: Taken to Task
Description: Defeat Kisare the Taskmaster to acquire the Taskmaster's Heart. Then report back to Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
Objective Proposal Response: The kind you do with your hands. The funny thing is that we still don't even know what the Ancients look like.
In Progress Response: Whatever elements you can recover from the corpse of the Taskmaster would be of greatest interest to me.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Did you defeat the Taskmaster? Amazing! Let me see what you found…

Title: Seeing Clearly (Expedition)
Description: Collect the Antiquarian's Eyepiece from Simon Grey in Amrine Excavation for Antiquarian Pajitnova in Windsward.
Objective Proposal Response: Simon. Simon Grey, one of the most brilliant researchers on Aeternum.
In Progress Response: You must think me callous, wanting Simon's Eyepiece, but I have already mourned Simon's loss.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So it's true then? Simon Grey became Lost, his soul never able to be repaired. Very sad.

Description: Simon Grey's dog Barkimedes is awaiting his master's return and is very hungry. From what you can tell he would appreciate having some Ravager bones to gnaw on.

Destination Completion Available Respons: Woof! (Barkimedes excitedly takes the bones… and promptly buries them.)

Description: Simon Grey's dog Barkimedes wants an enhanced bone-chewing experience from the Enchanted Bones of the Shattered Obelisk expedition.

In Progress Response: (Barkimedes is panting eagerly, waiting for the special bones.)
Destination Completion Available Respons: Woof, woof! (Barkimedes chews on the bones ravenously.)

Title: Pushing Back
Description: Eliminate the Corrupted in Weeping-and-Gnashing and Corpus Angoris, and recover any supplies left behind. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: It feels like the Corrupted keep getting stronger - I'm not sure how much longer we can defend this spot.
In Progress Response: Weaken the Corrupted's position in the forts so we can get supplies through to Clarion.
Destination Completion Available Respons: That was quite impressive, but somehow I'm not surprised. Now we can finally re-establish supply lines with Clarion.

Title: Our Own Worst Enemy
Description: Search for Soulwarden Heartgems across the five forts in Shattered Mountain, and search for any Corrupted writings. Then report back to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Bah, same as they do in the Cleave and everywhere else - they turn our own against us.
In Progress Response: Get me as many Heartgems as you can find and any Corrupted Writings.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well I'll be damned, you got more Heartgems than I expected. Sad is what that is.

Title: The Illurmin Rift
Description: Explore the deadly Illurmin Rift and deliver your discoveries to Warden Linch in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, but I wouldn't take the road.
In Progress Response: The things coming out of the Rift are scary enough to make you mess your smallclothes if you're not prepared.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I'll be a weathered knob on an Angry Spriggan's arse! Someone finally made it through!

Title: Guardians' Secrets
Description: Defeat Guardian Tzi-Wang, recover Baetylus Luckstones, and defeat Rockruins Guardians in Limbus Cavatus. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Well, I'm no bookish researcher like William Heron, but you have to admit - those Ancients knew some things.
In Progress Response: Limbus Cavatus is certainly a hike, I know... but it's worth a shot.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, thank goodness... You made it back! That bony wretch didn't give you too much trouble, I hope?

Title: Alligator Steaks
Description: Hunt Shattered Alligators for Gator Steaks and seek out bundles of Mirespice Blend held by the Desolate Scroungers. Then report back to Warden Douglas in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_explain" />I've been trying to think of a way to cheer people up, <g id="male_giveup" />but it's just not a cheery place.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_headnodding" />Shattered Gator Meat and Mirespice Blend, and then we'll be cooking… <g id="male_patience" />or is it better to eat it raw?
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_notsure" />I may have had… second thoughts… <g id="male_lookDown" />while you were away.

Title: Malevolent Offerings
Description: End the rituals in Hewn-from-Hell and Mantled-in-Nettles by eliminating the Corrupted Vicars, their guards, and their Corruption Barbs, then reclaim their Corrupted ritual implements. Then report back to Warden Linch in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Aye, and now we fight for our very souls, and those of every living creature on the face of the Earth.
In Progress Response: Whatever it takes, break up those rituals, destroy the Vicars, and take the implements of their evil.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Finally, an end to those infernal rituals! I can feel the difference already. We all can.

Title: Clarion Offensive
Description: Defeat Dau-Shin and recover Armor Scraps from the Rockrift Carvers in Limbus Cavatus. Then report back to Warden Fayed in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: I'm glad you agree. Before we can do so, however, we have to make ourselves less vulnerable.
In Progress Response: If we can get some of the armor from Limbus Cavatus, it will help us withstand the Corrupted.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Aha, a successful mission, I presume? Yes, Dau-Shin defeated and these armor scraps will do nicely.

Title: Knowledge is Power
Description: Get a fresh blight sample from a Blight Nodule in Wanhope Wold. Then report back to Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: We know some of the Corrupted in Edengrove have proven susceptible to the Blight.
In Progress Response: If you can get me fresh Blight samples, I can do the rest.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Aha, the procurer of the ingredients for my experiment!

Title: Blight Resistance
Description: Collect a Blight Sample from the Baleful Lair and defeat Fay, the Last Protector. Bring a piece of his remains to Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Ah, now that you mention it, I did notice some Angry Earth in the region that seem impervious.
In Progress Response: Fay and his band of Dryads are a force unto themselves.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Wait, you faced down Fay and survived to return? I must confess, I had my doubts.

Title: Madaki's Stratagem
Description: Search the forges of Infernal Host for any weapon molds or crucibles they might be using to forge weapons of great power. Then report back to Ranger Madaki in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Possibly. My study has indicated they need unique molds to properly complete each weapon.
In Progress Response: If it is possible to use these Ancient forging techniques, that is an advantage we need to deny the Corrupted…
Destination Completion Available Respons: You've returned. I'm impressed and cautiously optimistic. You found the crucibles?

Title: Baetylus Headpiece (Expedition)
Description: Defeat the Cilla in the Lazarus Instrumentality Expedition and Collect the Naga Headdress. Then report back to Warden Reese in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Definitely a dodgy place, in Reekwater. If you can find others as mad as you, it might be worth it.
In Progress Response: Are you really going to venture into the Lazarus Instrumentality…?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Welcome back to the front, {playerName}. Wait, the Lazarus Instrumentality? You can't mean…

Title: Ultimate Blight Defense (Expedition)
Description: Defeat the Alluvium Marl and Collect Alluvium Spores for Ranger Herath in Shattered Mountain.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, a sacred place for the Angry Earth, perhaps the most sacred.
In Progress Response: The Alluvium Marl in the Garden of Genesis, I have no idea what to expect…
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well, this is truly beyond the pale - you're the first I've seen venture into the Garden and return.

Title: The Tempest's Soul (Expedition)
Description: Enter Tempest's Heart and Defeat Isabella de Leon.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_nodYes" />Precisely. <g id="male_patience" />You have no doubt heard of the Tempest and have come seeking her ruin. But what do you know of Captain Isabella? <g id="male_spreadhands" />What does anyone know?
In Progress Response: <g id="female_thinking" />I have found accounts scattered across this island by those who had contact with Isabella. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />The story they tell is grim.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So it is true…<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> Isabella de Leon is no more. <g id="male_lookDown" />This is only the beginning.

Title: Isabella De Leon (Expedition)
Description: Find out about Isabella's past in Spain with her brothers. Then defeat Isabella de Leon again with this new knowledge in mind.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_explain" />We all have family. She also had brothers. <g id="female_thinking" />Could they have stopped Isabella's descent into madness?
In Progress Response: <g id="female_thinking" />I am curious to know whether our ill-fated Captain had help or hindrance from her brothers.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_nodYes" />Ah, so Philip and Cosimo squandered their fortune and family name away. <g id="female_thinking" />It's no wonder Isabella became so isolated and desperate.

Title: Isabella's Corruption (Expedition)
Description: Find out about how Isabella was offered the mantle of Corruption. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />But how can we know for sure?
In Progress Response: <g id="male_explain" />I left my convent to discover all I could about Isabella. The rumors of her fate frightened me. <g id="female_thinking" />But they also piqued my interest.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />It was a swift downfall then. Isabella ate the forbidden fruit with no remorse. <g id="male_crossarmsUpset" />This is... disheartening.

Title: Rise of Captain Isabella (Expedition)
Description: Find out about Isabella's descent into cruelty with her crew by investigating the graves where they were buried alive. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Still, I must believe that some part of the noble woman remained.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_convince01" />Please discover more about Isabella's trek across the island.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_worry" />She buried them alive? Oh God, she condemned them to the earth,<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> a terrible fate on Aeternum.

Title: Death of the Heretic (Expedition)
Description: Find out about the Heretic's true power and talk to the Heretic. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_shocked" />She was misled! That much I know for sure. Is the Heretic the source of Corruption? <g id="female_nodConsider" />That would explain it.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_rememberBig" />Aunt Isabella was as beautiful as an angel. <g id="female_bowShallow" />She was devout and prayed at Church often.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_drawbackAfraid" />You bring me a name I have never heard before: Nedenyek. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />It chills my very soul.

Title: The Possession of Russo (Expedition)
Description: Find out the truth about Isabella and Father Russo, and what is to come, and talk to Father Russo. Then defeat Isabella de Leon with this new knowledge in mind.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" />I do not know. Perhaps it is as you said <g id="male_spreadhands" />- Isabella had no one.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_lookforwardWonder" />In another life, perhaps Father Russo and Isabella could have been together. <g id="female_shakeheadNo" />We will never know.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_lookConcern" />So she turned away from Father Russo, who loved her with all of his heart.

Title: Isabella's Madness (Expedition)
Description: Recover a shard of Isabella's madness in the ashes of her defeat for Mara Rosa to study.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_nodYes" />That seems just.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />Have you collected another Shard of Madness? <g id="male_think" />Perhaps these memories will help point a way toward her salvation someday. We must always have hope.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_explain" />This Shard of Madness is full of pain. I shall store it with the others.

Title: To Be Free
Description: Free the baby tigers for Ma Xinyi.
Objective Proposal Response: Even if the babies make it out alive, I doubt their minds will be intact. The innocent animals. We must help them!
In Progress Response: Those predators! These cubs are only their most recent victims. But imagine if we could free them all…
Destination Completion Available Respons: The little ones roar their thanks. You have my gratitude, along with this humble reward.

Title: Scourging The Scourge
Description: Defeat Ivan The Scourge for Elder Danya.
Objective Proposal Response: WANTED by Order of Elder Danya: IVAN THE SCOURGE, Grave-Robber, now Lost Behemoth and Utter Nuisance, must be eliminated.
In Progress Response: WANTED by Order of Elder Danya: IVAN THE SCOURGE, Grave-Robber, now Lost Behemoth and Utter Nuisance, must be eliminated.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah! You've done us all a service. The reprobate made a habit of robbing graves before he lost his soul.

Title: Flowers for the Departed
Description: Place the flowers at Skysong Crypt to check if Elder Danya's comrades have found peace.
Objective Proposal Response: It's an ancient rite. Put a flower on a gravestone and if it blossoms there, the soul underneath lies peacefully.
In Progress Response: Have you placed the flowers at the crypt?
Destination Completion Available Respons: You're back at last! Did you place the flowers safely? Did they bloom? How are my friends? Tell me everything!

Title: The Corrupted Streak
Description: Defeat the group of Corrupted tigers for Ma Xinyi and end the cycle.
Player Prompt: "Did she come back for her cubs?"
Objective Proposal Response: Wishful thinking! The Corrupted forced her here to lure the cubs back to them. How do we break this cycle?
In Progress Response: Did you put the darlings to rest?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Tigers will always have a special place with me…

Title: The Mystery Within
Description: Help Yue study the Corrupted nodule at Imperial Army Campsite.
Player Prompt: "Why don't you take a closer look?"
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="litearmor_shocked" />I have no desire to get closer to Corrupted slime. <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />But perhaps you could examine it? I have a few coins that I can offer.
In Progress Response: <g id="litearmor_pleadhandsopen" />So, what do the Corrupted see in that that nodule?
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="litearmor_realize" />Ah, wonderful! Time to study this stone and understand how the Corrupted think…

Title: Treasured Trinkets
Description: Recover Chinese heirlooms from the Corrupted and give them to Yue so she can discover more about her past.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />Not even close. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />The Corrupted take over our land, our people and now our memories. <g id="litearmor_shrugbrief" />Why'd they need those artifacts, anyway?
In Progress Response: Any luck with the artifacts? Or are the Corrupted impossible to overcome?
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="litearmor_youknow" />I was an infant when I got here, and I know nothing of my old home — except from stories. <g id="litearmor_handheart" />This will help me learn of it!

Title: Sins of the Brothers
Description: Help Bardroy's sons, Bartolome and Bartholomew see sense and stop fighting each other.
Objective Proposal Response: I don't even remember what they're fighting over, and I doubt they do either. Killed each other repeatedly! I've had it. Go knock sense into 'em.
In Progress Response: I pray my boys are not too far gone. They may be addlepated idiots, but... they are mine.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Those reckless loons. My plan didn't work! They're still at each other's throats. But I'll find a way to make them see reason… despite this being Lost business.

Title: The Show Must Go On
Description: Get black ink from Void Pitchers so Magistrate Redridge may complete her play about the Empress.
Objective Proposal Response: No, no, no, that's not the answer. We give the wide-eyed masses an idea. A belief. We are more than a community. We are a symbol against darkness!
In Progress Response: Pray tell, did you get that fungus yet? The theatre eagerly awaits your contribution!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Splendid! With this, I can complete 'The Empress's Journey' — my script! For the Empress. And her people!

Title: Study In Green
Description: Acquire Dryad Wood for Artificer Long to craft robust armor against the Corrupted.
Objective Proposal Response: Everyone says the same. Yet where would she be without the throne she sits on, the shrines she commands? I built them all.
In Progress Response: Well? Don't you have the Dryad Wood yet? I am waiting.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh, I was right about you! Capable indeed - not many make it back alive. This wood will do nicely... The Empress thanks you!

Title: Statuette Stash
Description: Collect four Statuettes as told by handmaiden Zeng, to disrupt the Corrupted ritual.
Objective Proposal Response: Master Qi has said every soul that enters a temple leaves an imprint upon the place.
In Progress Response: Hurry and gather the other statues before it is too late. We can't let the Corrupted get a hold of such power!
Destination Completion Available Respons: I'll store these statues carefully. We don't want them to break and unleash... whatever Corruption lies within.

Title: Family Puzzles
Description: Return the puzzle box to Bardroy and discover the prize his sons were fighting to own.
Objective Proposal Response: You helped me previously. I don't mind sharing what’s inside… if you retrieve it. Deal? Still in some cargo the pirates filched from me long time back.
In Progress Response: Did you find my puzzle box yet? You wouldn't be able to open it without me, mind. In case the greed got you too…
Destination Completion Available Respons: So, the contents of this box? Rum aged one-hundred years. A legend of the seas! Caramel. Smoky. As smooth as a lady's glove.

Title: Shrine Cleansing
Description: Cleanse Skysong Temple for Artificer Long.
Objective Proposal Response: Cure the abominable royal child while Corruption infects the land. My shrine needs cleansing and nobody offers to help!
In Progress Response: Sigh. I knew it. You really didn't intend to help me either, did you? My poor shrine wilts! From the inside out!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You saw the shrine overrun with all manner of Corrupted horrors? I was afraid of that. Without cleansing, the Corrupted must have taken it over.

Title: Legacy Reclaimed
Description: Collect Passenger Scrolls from the Corrupted for Yue to study.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="litearmor_nodunderstand" />Exactly! Apparently, the cabin would have had a list of passengers. <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" priority="high"/>I may find other people who traveled with me!
In Progress Response: <g id="litearmor_realize" />Could the other passengers tell me about my life in China? <g id="litearmor_worry" priority="high"/>Oh! Don't let them be Corrupted or Lost!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="litearmor_compliment" />You did it! Please, let me see. <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" priority="high"/>Hm… According to this, a perfumer called Muthalaly was on the same journey.

Title: The Red Claw
Description: Collect a Crimson Paw from Redclaw for a red dye for Xiang Enlai.
Objective Proposal Response: They're used in the Hair Combing ceremony. And that will protect us as a couple… if she'll have me.
In Progress Response: You will keep the details of this task between us, correct? I want Yue to think I fought the Red Claw myself.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The Red Claw! Defeated? You're brave, like Yue. I hope she likes the red string and says 'yes'. Then we'll be married!

Title: Serenity In Chaos
Description: Destroy Corrupted forces at Serenity Monastery. Then report back to Artificer Long.
Objective Proposal Response: Gathering intelligence for when the time is right to use it.
In Progress Response: Did you disrupt the meeting, or were you too busy thinking about what I should and shouldn't have done?
Destination Completion Available Respons: The Empress's mind was clouded. I can see that yours is much clearer. I do value everything you've done for me.

Title: Strings of Fate
Description: Retrieve red strings from Dynasty Corrupted for Xiang Enlai and Yue.
Objective Proposal Response: Not quite. Yue wants the red strings the Imperial Guards use for their armor. It is tangible fabric. Could you help me once again?
In Progress Response: Once Yue and I are married, we'll spend our honeymoon in Everfall. I hear they have a never-ending banquet there.
Destination Completion Available Respons: These are the perfect strings. I can't wait to show them to Yue. She'll say 'yes' to me now!

Title: Revenge of a Playwright
Description: Sabotage the Corrupted operations as payback for spoiling Redridge's play.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes… Yes! We've been gentle with the Corrupted for too long. Think therefore on revenge and cease to weep!
In Progress Response: Let's teach the Corrupted it's NEVER a good idea to mess with the arts!
Destination Completion Available Respons: The Corrupted deserved everything you gave them and more. They will rue the day they hurt our Empress and my play!

Title: End of Her Reign (Expedition)
Description: Defeat Empress Zhou Taiying and her Captains. Then report back to Zeng Lingyun in the Ebonscale Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: I'd ask Liang for help, but his wounds are too fresh. Corrupted Empress Zhou besieges the docks with her 'loyal' handmaidens.
In Progress Response: I will wish you good fortune. Empress Zhou Taiying was always formidable. Perhaps even more so now in her Corruption…
Destination Completion Available Respons: News of your valor has reached us! It was a sad thing to ask of you… but I am grateful. The shipyards are safe. For now…

Title: Justice For The Dynasty (Expedition)
Description: Obtain Dynasty Shackles from Dynasty Shipyard Lieutenants and return them to Liberator Guo outside the Dynasty Shipyards In Ebonscale.
Objective Proposal Response: You stand at the precipice of a critical operation for Ebonscale Reach. The people of Zhou Taiying's Dynasty have been betrayed by her turn to Corruption.
In Progress Response: Taking these shackles away from the upper members of her court give adventurers and innocents a fighting chance in running from Taiying's terror.
Destination Completion Available Respons: These devices are truly the tools of an oppressor. On behalf of the people of the Dynasty, I thank you. We will melt these down and make something good of them.

Title: The Invasion of Artemis
Description: Morgaine requests your assistance to battle the Ancient Huntress Artemis and the Angry Earth in Elysian Wilds. Collect seeds for an inoculate to enter and then work with the rangers and druids of the region to assess the enemy.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />To think that one of the Ancients walked among us all this time! Huh! And you managed to prevent her awakening Sutekh! <g id="male_ragepunchfistsdown" />Such chaos!
In Progress Response: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Collect those seeds, young one. Artemis wastes not a<g id="male_crossarmsUpset" priority="high" /> moment and neither shall we.
