Title: Into the Wilds
Description: Morgaine requests that you travel west in search of survivors and Hargest's rangers. Help whoever you can, bring back any survivors, and if possible find a means to investigate the horrors beyond the inner bramble walls.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, particularly with this revelation that Artemis may have some twisted intent for them.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />We must discern the Huntress's full intentions, <g id="female_lookConcern" />however depressing that may be.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_lookConcern" />That was… frightening. Images of terror and evil creatures of legend... <g id="female_thinking" />were they hallucinations? Let us hope.

Title: Into the Darkness
Description: Morgaine once again needs our assistance breaking through into the lowland jungles for Captain Hargest, so that we can investigate the destroyed settlement of First Light. Help Hargest and her rangers make it down safely.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, you do that. I must consult Myrddin's tomes. Minotaurs, gorgons, massive beasts... this is unprecedented.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_explain" />If the survivor's memories are to be believed, atrocities beyond imagination are under way in the old settlement. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />We must get there, and with haste!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_cheerFistpump" />Luck was with us! I found a few rangers dazed by the spores, and I saw you helping one yourself… <g id="female_lookConcern" />I just hope they get back to camp.

Title: Survivalist's Revenge
Description: Hargest thinks we should investigate Dayspring Mills on our way to the settlement, and evidence suggests that Albert Riches may be fighting back. Travel into the overgrown village and search for whatever clues you can find.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_nod1" />Sure enough, and he may have a grip on the situation at the settlement.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_cheerFisthigh" />We've got a foothold, and that's progress! <g id="female_crossarms" />Wouldn't be surprised to get a cheer when I tell everyone back at camp.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_spreadhands" />Welcome to the settlement of Elysian Wilds, <g id="female_shrugShort" />or what's left of it. <g id="female_bowDeep" />Constable Magistrate Riches, at your service... <g id="female_shrugShort" />whatever title you prefer.

Title: First Light, Last Stand
Description: Albert Riches needs reinforcements! Travel northwest to Tanglesnap Hollows where Taurus disposed a chunk of the spirit shrine, destabilizing its effectiveness. It may be a longshot, but forage for ingredients to repair the shrine and correct its power to allow our allies safe passage.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_nodConsider" />Ah, now there's smart thinking! <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I like it! <g id="male_explain" />The Huntress's pet minotaur smashed the shrine good though,<g id="female_spreadarms" /> sent stone work flying way out!
In Progress Response: <g id="female_nodConsider" />I have to admit, things were starting to get a little dark both outside... and inside my head at one point. <g id="male_handheart" />It's been better since you arrived. Much better.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_laughCocky" />Well, that was a fight for the ages! I'd say after today, <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />we won't give the leaf lady another inch of this land!

Title: Abducted Artificer
Description: Survivalist Riches implores us for aid, saving his kidnapped friend Jihoon Kim. Kim was captured by Medusa in the initial invasion, but Riches recently spotted him being dragged east to Saircor, go rescue the Artificer if you can.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Not sure, but it didn't sound good. Jihoon Kim - <g id="male_explain" />the town artificer a mechanical genius - Artemis said she had a special project for Kim, and that's all I know.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_lookConcern" />I'm not the most trusting man. <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Artificer Kim is the best friend I have. <g id="male_pointsoutthere" />You have to get him out of there.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />Even when I heard the sounds of battle, I hardly believed it possible. <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />I have been down here more days than I can count.

Title: Escaping The Ruins
Description: Jihoon Kim believes Medusa and Artemis stole an item of importance and stashed it at Portico Tideswallow. If the item is recovered, it may convince the Minotaur there is something sinister going on with Artemis and the Beast Lords.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_agree1" />Yes, please don't ask for any more details. I worked on the machine for weeks, <g id="female_lookDownGuilty" />and then I saw… only the beginning.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_hopeless" />I had given up hope of ever seeing a human face again. <g id="male_clenchfistsAngry" />I will never forget what I have endured.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Well done. You are indeed a formidable warrior, <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />and I am deeply in your debt for my liberation.

Title: Maze and the Minotaur
Description: Kim asks that we boldly brave the Labyrinth of the minotaur Taurus, Northeast of the Ancient ruins, so that we may speak to him. Survive the deadly challenges within, and parley with the beastman if you can.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_think" />These Beast Lords with whom Artemis has forged an alliance would seem to be the final part of her plan.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_guiltyLookdown" />I… am so sorry… for my hand in aiding them with that Ancient device. <g id="male_outfitashamed" />I didn't know the purpose they intended until it was too late. It must be destroyed.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So you see, I swear no allegiance to the Huntress, and I do not war with humanity, unless provoked.

Title: Lord of the Pride
Description: To forge an alliance with the Beast Lords we will first need to prove ourselves to them. Taurus suggests that we begin with the Lion Lord Shirzad to the north in Shirzad's Pride. Complete his challenge and gain an audience.
Objective Proposal Response: The Beast Lords are primal powers, far beyond anything you or I can imagine. If they war, they will win.
In Progress Response: Shirzad will grant you audience, but be wary on approach. His Pride will not tolerate trespassers.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You stood your ground with honor and fought with skill. Shirzad shall grant you an audience.

Title: The Proving Grounds
Description: Shirzad has listened to our plea and is willing to entertain our propositions for now. Travel west to Kurok's Anchorage and speak with the Gorilla Lord Kurok. Deliver Shirzad's message and gain an audience with the Lord.
Objective Proposal Response: … If the Huntress seeks to trick us in this alliance, you will need no bargain, human. We will seek our own vengeance.
In Progress Response: Be wary of Mahantaram; he has not been himself.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You are… no normal human. That is sure. You fought with great strength, and while you fought, I communed with Shirzad.

Title: Rage of the Mammoth
Description: Kurok has accepted our bid of peace for now, and is willing to reconvene with Shirzad over their fate on Aeternum. He now worries for his kin Mahantaram, the final Lord. Head east to the Trampled Lands, and face the mammoth.
Objective Proposal Response: Go quickly, for even as we speak, I stretch out to commune with him, and Mahantaram does not respond.
In Progress Response: I sense strange changes within Mahantaram's soul, and I hear the thunder of his tribe resounding in the earth.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Soulwarden! How long has it been? Much has transpired since you left, and the magic in this land swirls into a maelstrom.

Title: Garden of the Gorgon
Description: Morgaine entreats us to retrieve the Tear of Gaea at all costs, but first we must defeat Medusa. Taurus already makes his way to her vile gardens south west of the ranger camp. Slay the Gorgon and drive her from these lands.
Player Prompt: "The Minotaur and I will defeat her."
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_explainS" />Then you will need protection from her gaze unless you want to be turned to stone! And you are fortunate to have a friend like Morgaine.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_worry" />I can only hope that Trahern and I have the magic and knowledge you will need to stop what Artemis has begun.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I do not revel in the suffering of others, <g id="female_nodRelieved" />but the cries of Medusa were like a fresh wind of hope.

Title: Arcana Aligned
Description: Trahern and Morgaine believe they may have devised a means of capturing Artemis and securing the Tear. Meet Morgaine up the road in the high mountains of what is now Scalefang Enclave to see what magic she has in mind.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_headNodYes" />I hope so. We can only sow the seeds of possibility; nature must determine whether we harvest good fortune.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />Go swift and stay strong. We will need your abilities in the battle to come. Defeating Artemis will take great effort.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Well done. What we have achieved here by siphoning these Ancient energies is very similar to what Myrddin did to first empower his Staff of Wizardry.

Title: One With Nature
Description: Morgaine directs us upward to the bloom above. With our Azoth Staff now empowered by the arcane energies channeled from Elafry Pyrgo we have but one more component to secure. Fight with Trahern, claim it, and finish the spell.
Player Prompt: "So the staff will be the key."
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Precisely. Unlike the Archdruid, <g id="female_suppresslaugh" />your skills in comprehension are intact. Trahern does have a role to play however.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_crossarms" />Do not concern yourself. I am more than capable of battling my way safely to the tower.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />This goes beyond anything Myrddin ever attempted. <g id="male_nodProud" />I am proud to have assisted you.

Title: The End of New Eden
Description: Morgaine puts forth her final plea - capture Artemis and secure the Tear of Gaea from her grasp. With your allies at your back, ascend Elafry Pyrgo and battle the Ancient Artemis for the fate of the region, Aeternum, and the World.
Player Prompt: "What do I do with the Tear?"
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />Heh. That is an excellent question, and I will need to think on it, <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />but it should not delay us now.
In Progress Response: Even if we fail, Soulwarden, <g id="female_salute2finger" />I am proud of what we have accomplished together…<g id="female_shrugNothingicando" /> in scholarly terms, at least.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_nodRelieved" />We have averted the ascension of an Ancient, and yet there remains more to do. <g id="female_worry" />I fear what could befall the Beast Lords following their affliction.

Title: Secret of the Spores
Description: Master Alchemist Eadred has made a revolutionary discovery critical to the invasion. Investigate the strange spores blooming in the region and learn how you can use them to your advantage.\n(Requires: Harvesting 100)
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_explain" />I believe I have devised a method to render the toxic effects beneficial to us. <g id="male_gestureDownRight" priority="high" />It requires ingredients gathered from the plants themselves.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />It seems everything in this land wants to kill us. <g id="female_disagreeCrossarms" />I suppose that shouldn't be so surprising.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />Look at that, you’re glowing... <g id="male_wavehandPshaw" />I jest, of course. Remember to keep your flask in tip top shape.

Title: Endangered by Artemis
Description: The Druid Keira implores you to aid the wildlife native to the region. The cries of animals call out from the depths of the jungle, and she feels their fear. Do what you can to keep them from becoming food for some new monstrosity.
Objective Proposal Response: If we're quick about it. I have a special connection to the wild things. Their cries… they’re coming from the south.
In Progress Response: We don’t know what other horrors were spawned by the transformation of this land. Be cautious.
Destination Completion Available Respons: All is calm now. The animals sing with gratitude for their freedom. Thank you for giving them a second chance.

Title: A Beast No More
Description: Sebastian Vachon is pursuing a dangerous beast and needs your help finding it so he can study its origins. Follow its tracks through the region, defeat it, and bring its cerebrum back to the Druid.
Objective Proposal Response: I can find out. If you wish to help, slay the beast and bring me its brain. With that, I can divine the answer.
In Progress Response: Some rangers claim to have encountered a creature such as this near the overgrown barrier deep within the mining town.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have the brain? Let me examine it…

Title: Firing Back
Description: Albert Riches, the survivalist of First Light left behind some battle plans and a note. How did he know we would be coming? In any case, we should help. Go into Charlottesburgh and complete the Survivalist's bombastic plan.
Objective Proposal Response: The plant-men made a home of Dayspring. Dragged townsfolk there when it started… into the pods.
In Progress Response: There is a hastily sketched diagram of a farmhouse surrounded by explosives. Stick figure Angry Earth are rushing towards it.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_wipetear" />Scuse me, lad. Think I got something in my eye. <g id="male_ragepoundfist" />We lost a lot of good people when those leafy bastards showed.

Title: A Friend in Need
Description: Another potential survivor, James Oxen, appears to have dropped a check-list of supplies. There is a crude drawing of a cave on the back. Collect the supplies, find the cave, and protect the survivors.
Objective Proposal Response: It's an extremely verbose note. The handwriting becomes increasingly hurried, ending in the bloodstained signature of a "Captain James Oxen."
In Progress Response: It's an extremely verbose note. The handwriting becomes increasingly hurried, ending in the bloodstained signature of a "Captain James Oxen."
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_notsure" />I'm not seeing things? I thought I'd die here on this God-forsaken island. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />You have my eternal thanks, mate!

Title: Tracking the Herd
Description: The Knight-Errant Fionn hopes we can render some assistance investigating the migratory behavior of the beasts moving between the nearby territory and the northern beastlands. Follow the clues and report back.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_explain" />Migratory patterns to confirm they're heading for a choke point the Marauders picked out.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Travel south along the coast and try not to get spotted. These beasts are just like the rest of Aeternum's wildlife -<g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> vicious and territorial.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />How was the investigation? You look like you ran into something dangerous.

Title: Plague for All Factions
Description: Ramla and her crew have come down with a mysterious illness. Something dangerous has awoken in these ruins and someone tough will be needed to investigate. See if you can solve the mystery.
Objective Proposal Response: I would prefer the surprises to stop. The symptoms are nothing particularly unique, but no treatments are working.
In Progress Response: The Syndicate are held up here instead of setting up power for the Marauders.
Destination Completion Available Respons: An alchemist told us our "curse" was some Ancient defense mechanism, but I dismissed the idea until the sickness faded.

Title: Defective Defenses
Description: Josephine and her Syndicate specialists were ambushed when they set off some form of automated defense system within Tideswallow. Now they need someone to deal with the Ancient Guardians and finish the repairs.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_headnodding" />Got a knack for this do you? <g id="female_explainS" />If you gather up enough Ancient scraps, maybe you can fix the pylons. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Then you may need some Ancient tomes, for setting the runes.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_explainS" />I don't mind waiting, but I can't say the same for the Marauders.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_headnodding" />All fixed? Us too. <g id="male_explain" />With the pylons repaired, our expert in Ancient machinery can attempt to gain control of the defenses.

Title: Factions United
Description: The flow of power has been restored to the Marauders at Saircor, and Kievan needs help with the final step of the operation. Fight off the Ancient Guardians and assist with the repairs so he can gain control of their defenses.
Objective Proposal Response: Looks can be deceiving, da? This will not be easy, friend. You have demonstrated mastery over Ancient Guardians. Show us Marauders another performance!
In Progress Response: Every moment we delay, our foes continue their relentless advance. The man-beast to the north must not be allowed to amass his armies unchecked.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Haha! Run, cowards! Though I take great pride in Marauder victory over the Ancient Guardians, I am even more impressed by the strength of Aeternum united.

Title: The Heart of a Beast
Description: Pinned beneath a mysterious, rusted axe lies a note - addressed to you. It asks that you hold your judgment of the fabled Minotaur until you learn his story. Collect relics lost in the labyrinth, then speak with Marwa.
Objective Proposal Response: “The Minotaur could be a force of wanton destruction, but he chooses not to be. He is hunted purely due to lies and falsehoods.
In Progress Response: The note instructs you to find three relics within the labyrinth and deliver them to Marwa.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Taurus… Minotaur… Enkidu... he has gone by many names. I healed him after he was attacked in Weaver’s Fen decades ago. Now we fight side by side.

Title: Challenge of Character
Description: Marwa Shaheen has heard of your recent exploits, and knows more trials lie ahead. She wishes to offer a challenge to bolster your resolve. Visit Marwa and complete the time trial that she has prepared.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_itemGiveRight" />Take this torch and light the braziers I have placed across this land.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_order" />Your flame dwindles. Hasten to the braziers!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_headnodding" />Masterfully done. You have no doubt gained favor with Taurus. <g id="female_giveitem" />Here is your reward.

Title: Gauntlet of Kings
Description: Shirzad believes you must increase in strength if you are to quell the rage of the tainted Beast Lords and their tribes. Return to his den at Shirzad's Pride and once again brave the grotto below.
Player Prompt: "No beast or man will stop me."
Objective Proposal Response: Then descend once more into the caverns of my kin, and defeat any who stand in your way. Do not relent and you shall be victorious.
In Progress Response: The idle are not fit to lead.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Once again you prove yourself a mighty warrior. Perhaps you have the soul of a lion? You have my boon, human. Be welcome in my domain.

Title: Battle of the Beasts
Description: Barug of the Gorillas now stands in Kurok's stead, but without their Lord the tribe is in grave danger. Rally your fellow warriors to help the Gorilla tribe fight off an incursion by a champion of the Lizard Lord.
Objective Proposal Response: With most of our allied Lords sequestered in the cavern, our tribe remains in great danger. Fight Gazsala in the bay. Fight with everything you have.
In Progress Response: I struggle to maintain order in Nyhart's without Kurok. If Sirrussu spreads his malign influence here, others of their kind will surely invade.
Destination Completion Available Respons: My thanks, human. I offer you our boon. We weep for the Lords that are lost, and hope they may return to us in time. We need their guidance now more than ever.

Title: The Tribunal Highmound
Description: Manmosu, the new matriarch of the mammoth tribe, has taken refuge in a cave near the Tribunal Highmound to prepare for battle. Speak with her, and then prepare to assault the Highmound and its leaders.
Objective Proposal Response: You think as I do, human. Focus on eliminating the leaders. Their contagion spreads quickly if they are left to prowl.
In Progress Response: Maintain dominance or this land will dominate you.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Impressive. I wish more within the herd had your conviction. It’s time to face the Lords within their new domain.

Title: Medusa's Monstrosities
Description: Johannes Metzger needs assistance investigating the sinister magic Medusa had been channeling in Scalefang Enclave. Reach out to the rogue scientist, help him gather samples, and work with the mysterious technology there.
Objective Proposal Response: Limbs. Guts. Brains. What else? You've skinned a deer before, yes? It's like that, but keep the bits you'd throw out.
In Progress Response: You will not find the Hercyne by nettling me further, assistant. Get moving!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have an uncanny aptitude for dissection. These samples are perfect! By studying these component parts I'll learn the intricacies of merging with Angry Earth.

Title: Medusa's Magic
Description: Johannes Metzger has even grander ambitions. Too grand to accomplish alone. Find him in the dark village and Help him with his final tasks, and he promises to share part of the credit for whatever he learns.
Player Prompt: "I'm as ready as I'll ever be."
Objective Proposal Response: That's the spirit! There are pylons like mine scattered around Scalefang Enclave.
In Progress Response: Hop to, assistant! You know what they say about idle hands…
Destination Completion Available Respons: My Syndicate cluster warned me not to rush progress… I believe I understand now.

Title: The Siege of Light's Crown
Description: Ranger-Captain Hargest has advanced into inner Light's Crown to establish a perimeter, but she needs assistance. Help the rangers restock their munitions, bolster their defenses, and fend off attacks.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_gestureLeft" />We can use these barricades to create a choke point. <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />We need to funnel the enemy into cannon range.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_convince01" />Once this cannon is operational, <g id="male_clenchFistRight" />we will command the battlefield.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_compliment" />Excellent work! We've got a much stronger foothold here now. <g id="female_salute2finger" />Your quick thinking saved the day.

Title: Essence of Evil
Description: Heinrich Gauss has been dispatched to investigate the dark energy pouring out of Elafry Pyrgo and assess its potential danger to the humans of Aeternum. Help him to gather samples using his proprietary capture devices.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_headNodYes" />You are far better equipped for the job…<g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" /> Take my latest creation with you.
In Progress Response: <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />You mustn't linger long. I want to capture the storm's full ferocity.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_salute2FingersFast" />Were you successful in collecting the… <g id="female_lookConcern" />you look like you’ve seen a ghost. What happened up there?

Title: The Savage Divide (Expedition)
Description: The time has come to face the Beast Lords lost within the Savage Divide. Manmosu asks that we act as her champion, lest she risk infection by going herself. Gather your greatest allies, descend into the Divide, and defeat the Lords.
Objective Proposal Response: Unfortunately, he isn’t the only Beast Lord within the depths of the Highmound Caverns. The gorilla lord Kurok is inside as well.
In Progress Response: Stay vigilant. You may have defeated Mahantaram before, but the foulness festering within him makes him unpredictable.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I can feel his grip weakening on the herd. With time, the power he holds over us will diminish.

Title: Among the Statues
Description: Dame Edith Henrietta Shackleton has gotten herself into a bit of a situation in the maze. She requires help acquiring antiquities that have been turned to stone.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_nodProud" />I'm no dunce. I studied the Classics, and have an encyclopedic knowledge of mythology.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_impatient" />Have you recovered those artifacts yet? I'm getting tired from holding this position.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_compliment" />Splendid work! Just splendid! Imagine, this vase, if it hadn't been turned to stone, would have been as fragile as an eggshell.

Title: FM  R09  PVP  Control Spot  Marauder objective
FM  R09  PVP  Control Spot  Syndicate objective
FM  R09  PVP  Control Spot  Covenant objective
Containing the Contagion (Expedition)
Description: Archdruid Trahern has been hard at work researching methods for combating the magical plants spreading throughout the Savage Divide. He needs your assistance planting his newly created seeds within the depths of the cavern.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_explain" />We use Medusa’s magic against her. These seeds will absorb the taint and purify it before bursting into pristine flora.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_disagreeRighthandout" />Be careful, there are many infected creatures inside the cavern. If at all possible, try to give them a swift end. <g id="male_shakehead" />They've already suffered enough.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_saluteFistchest" />I’m glad you made it back safely. The seeds should prevent new infections from spreading.

Title: Welcome to Cutlass
Description: The ever magnanimous Patricia Reid wishes to welcome you to Spyglass Ridge and Cutlass Keys. Do her a favor, and speak to some of her friends, will ya?
Objective Proposal Response: Something <g id="litearmor_chuckle" priority="high />like that… name’s Pat, and I make it a point to know everyone in town. <g id="litearmor_youknow" />Like to keep my finger on the pulse of the place, you see?
In Progress Response: Grimm and Oxen, they're both characters, alright.
Destination Completion Available Respons: That table has treasure aplenty, <g id="litearmor_complimentplayer" />and there's more where that came from. So come back after your adventures; bring back a haul of doubloons.

Title: Pirate's Life For Me
Description: First Mate Grimm waits eagerly in the tavern to tell the tale of the cursed doubloons to any and all newcomers. Hear his words and listen well.
Objective Proposal Response: Well, not so much a tale as a nightmare. Those doubloons that everyone's after... nobody knows the power they hold. The madness they inflict…
In Progress Response: Sit down already, we’re in a damned tavern! Rest your legs and feel the fire. You don’t always need to be in such a rush… This won’t take long.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Now, listen and listen well. Those doubloons are mine by right, and I aim to destroy the lot! I brought the curse here, and I aim to rectify that.

Title: It Crawls Beneath Us
Description: James Oxen is seeking a cure for the curse that turned his crew to stone. Speak to Glendyn Trahern in southeastern Cutlass Keys for answers.
Objective Proposal Response: We found Medusa, <g id="litearmor_hopeless" />but she was not alone! Her ravenous brood ripped my crew to pieces. The lucky ones were turned to stone. I- I jumped ship and swam to shore…
In Progress Response: The carnage... <g id="litearmor_worry" />there's not enough ale in this tavern to wash away what these eyes have seen…
Destination Completion Available Respons: Greetings, old friend. You must have spoken with Oxen, if you came looking for me here. I'm afraid the captain's story is true... Medusa has returned.

Title: Flesh From Stone (Expedition)
Description: The Broodmother Medusa has turned Oxen's crew to stone and is spawning hordes of Hercyne to claim Aeternum. Gather ingredients for the antidote and defeat her.
Objective Proposal Response: Just the attitude Nature needs from the Hero of Aeternum! There's an antidote I can brew. The ingredients can be found in the Hive beyond.
In Progress Response: Make haste! The longer we dally, the more of her brood will spill forth to contaminate this land!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have my thanks, hero. I only pray that I have the knowledge and intellect necessary to decipher the mysteries of those who came before.

Title: Smell the Future
Description: Arnold Trost has discovered Lost are repulsed by man-sized sticks of burning incense. Venture into The Salty Marshes and light a Lost Deterrence Pylon to keep them out of Spyglass Ridge.
Objective Proposal Response: It's pure incense, according to Fei, if you can imagine that. I don't think anyone expected those waterlogged corpses to be mindful of strong smells.
In Progress Response: Every minute you delay the Lost get more organized.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh my... I don't know what's worse. The Lost or the smell of that incense... I guess it beats being overrun and beaten to death by a horde of withered ghouls…

Title: Keys to Freedom
Description: Spymaster Bronn wants you to cause a distraction in Pirate's Stand by unleashing the encaged Ancient Guardians upon their jailers. With the enemy occupied, find the prison key and release the pirate captives to bolster our ranks.
Objective Proposal Response: They turn their captives into new crew members. I’ll spare you the grim details of that process. If we save 'em, they'll be in our debt. That's what matters.
In Progress Response: Be careful, I don’t want to see you in one of those cages. We’re running thin as it is.
Destination Completion Available Respons: A rough lot you saved. We’ll have to vet them before offering our supplies and arms, but I have a feelin' they'll prove their worth. Good work.

Title: A Shocking Revelation
Description: Help Billiam Rowen with the discovery of his lifetime by defeating the Spectral Tyrant and ridding his cave of Lost! Return to Billiam in Cutlass Keys when you've finished.
Objective Proposal Response: Ah, yes! I’ve been charting the skies above Aeternum for years now and stumbled across quite the revelation. Perhaps you’d like to sit down before I tell you.
In Progress Response: Oh, how I long for the sea at times… But the skies are a rather compelling alternative. I do hope you’re faring well with my request friend!
Destination Completion Available Respons: I can’t thank you enough. As long as those Lost stay away, I can confirm my research and seal our names in the history books of this great island!

Title: Whispers of Wealth
Description: A collector named Edwin Kasper is haunted by a voice that demands the recovery of artifacts lost among the shipwrecks of Cutlass Keys. Search for a golden beam to the south west and return the artifacts to satisfy the mysterious voice and save Kasper's sanity.
Objective Proposal Response: Please, help me. I hear a voice… it hungers for artifacts that it once possessed.
In Progress Response: I wish I never found this cursed relic. It's sheer torture what it's putting me through.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You found them! Surely, surely this is enough to appease it. I hope… at least. Thank you, friend.

Title: Soul Trap
Description: Rosina Bryce's search for supernatural rumors have led her to The Bloody Spike. Defeat warriors living and dead to collect enough Soul Gems for an offering, and see fortune bestowed by The Bloody Spike.
Objective Proposal Response: Legend has it living and Lost are both naturally drawn to this spire, and the bloodshed surrounding it hardens the soul into gemstones at the moment of death.
In Progress Response: You won't find any gemstones standing around, I'd get moving if I were you.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So the legends are true? The Bloody Spike was feeding off your actions, wasn't it? And you return with the gemstones to boot… well done.

Title: For Guts and Glory
Description: Get your hands dirty and defeat other fighters at the Citadel. Return to Decima Opimius when you have a story worth telling.
Objective Proposal Response: Sure have. I can crack a few skulls, sure, but fighting’s not really for me. A spatula’s a bit more my speed. If you’re heading to the Citadel, best prepare!
In Progress Response: Oh, come now, your stories aren’t nearly good enough to earn your reward yet. Get back to the Citadel and stand your ground!
Destination Completion Available Respons: That… Well, goodness! That might actually keep me up at night. I wouldn't have thought you could be so vicious. Hope I never disappoint you with my meals!

Title: Smell the Future
Description: Arnold Trost has discovered Lost are repulsed by man-sized sticks of burning incense. Venture into The Salty Marshes and light a Lost Deterrence Pylon to keep them out of Spyglass Ridge.
Objective Proposal Response: It surely does. We should light more! Keeping pressure on the Lost will ensure they stay busy knocking down incense instead of our doors.
In Progress Response: I know it's it's dirty work, but it must be done. Get out to the swamp and place more pylons as soon as you can.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Another batch planted? Good. We're all a little safer.

Title: Keys to Freedom
Description: Spymaster Bronn wants you to cause a distraction in Pirate's Stand by unleashing the encaged Ancient Guardians upon their jailers. With the enemy occupied, find the prison key and release the pirate captives to bolster our ranks.
Objective Proposal Response: Those Sable Fleet bastards are on high alert since your raid. They also managed to capture even more prisoners. We'll need to break them out.
In Progress Response: I hope you get to the captives before the Sable Fleet enact their judgement. We don’t need even more soulless pirates wandering Cutlass Keys.
Destination Completion Available Respons: These scallywags look even worse than the last bunch, but they'll increase our strength in numbers, and we should be on the lookout for more in the future.

Title: A Shocking Revelation
Description: Help Billiam Rowen with the discovery of his lifetime by defeating the Spectral Tyrant and ridding his cave of Lost! Return to Billiam in Cutlass Keys when you've finished.
Objective Proposal Response: Maybe we'll get lucky and that fiend won't be there… maybe. I can't tell how important this is for me to continue my studies.
In Progress Response: The night sky is like a vast sea, with constellations as its beautiful creatures. I wonder if I’ll ever come across a manatee star pattern…?
Destination Completion Available Respons: I can’t thank you enough. As long as those Lost stay away, I can confirm my research and seal our names in the history books of this great island!

Title: Whispers of Wealth
Description: A collector named Edwin Kasper is haunted by a voice that demands the recovery of artifacts lost among the shipwrecks of Cutlass Keys. Search for a golden beam to the south west and return the artifacts to satisfy the mysterious voice and save Kasper's sanity.
Objective Proposal Response: You’ve been a boon in this wretched situation. Find the golden beam to the south as before. That should lead you to the artifacts.
In Progress Response: I pray this is the last of it. I can’t take much more…
Destination Completion Available Respons: These must be the last pieces. It has to be. Thank you for not running off with such valuables. Your honor in a land of thieves is to be commended.

Title: Soul Trap
Description: Rosina Bryce's search for supernatural rumors have led her to The Bloody Spike. Defeat warriors living and dead to collect enough Soul Gems for an offering, and see fortune bestowed by The Bloody Spike.
Objective Proposal Response: What do you say we extend our previous deal? Bring us more gems and I'll ensure you find even more fortune.
In Progress Response: I wouldn't keep The Spike waiting.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The Bloody Spike and I are pleased, we hope to see you again soon.

Title: For Guts and Glory
Description: Get your hands dirty and defeat other fighters at the Citadel. Return to Decima Opimius when you have a story worth telling.
Objective Proposal Response: That's the spirit! Get back down to the Citadel and get your hands dirty. I'll get mine dirty too, just with flour... not blood.
In Progress Response: A dash of cinnamon and perhaps some smoked paprika… Are you allergic to anything? Just trying to make you something special for when you get back.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Are you determined to keep me up at night?! That was disgusting. Well, I suppose I did ask for it, and I hate to admit you've left me wanting even more!

Title: Out of the Frying Pan
Description: Return the set of pots and pans to Cook Swampy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Normally I'd recommend the Cutlass Quiche. But can you believe it, there are some around here who don't appreciate my cooking! My cooking!
In Progress Response: Have you recovered me pots and pans yet? I once used that frying pan to hit a patron who didn’t pay up. He doesn’t remember it, probably from the concussion.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, let's see… that's them! No better pans in all Aeternum! Oh, I can kiss ya.

Title: In Search of Plunder
Description: Explore Ancient ruins to collect artifacts. Search chests to collect Heron's notes. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: Word is the Ancient ruins might have some good ol' fashioned plunder in them. A man by the name of Heron came through town a while back, saying as much.
In Progress Response: All that plunder isn't going to go fall into our laps without some effort! Explore the ruins and bring back what artifacts you find.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Now, that's a sight to behold! Look at all of this beautiful plunder. This is exactly the type of booty a pirate town needs!

Title: Relics of the Tower
Description: Loot relics from chests inside Crow's Nest Lighthouse. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: Well for starters, you can find some more of those artifacts. I bartered the last batch for more than its weight in gold!
In Progress Response: It's not as fun as plundering another ship at sea, but raiding ruins is still quite lucrative. And you don't get seasick, neither!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Magnificent! What unusual artifacts. I'm sure we will have no trouble finding a buyer. I dare say a return to the spire for more may be in order!

Title: Explosive Prospecting
Description: Investigate the source of the tremors in the Highpass Mining Camp and defuse the situation. Talk to Captain Lucian in Spyglass Ridge when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: There's an old mining camp in Pirate's Pass. A band of Lost pirates recently laid claim to it and I fear they may be up to something sinister.
In Progress Response: What we don't need is a landslide ruining our fine settlement. Investigate the mining camp and put a stop to their plans.
Destination Completion Available Respons: We'll all sleep safer at night without those explosions rattling the cupboards, but I fear the pirates may soon return.

Title: Lightning in a Bottle
Description: Find elemental materials from spirits and bring them back to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: You have no doubt seen the numerous specters and phantasms that wander among the Lost. Some of these spirits even display strange elemental properties.
In Progress Response: We have to find a better way to fight back against the Lost. Perhaps the bottled lightning is the edge we need.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, yes. These will do nicely! Give me some time to prepare the device, and when you return we will begin the next phase of our work!

Title: Lightning Unleashed
Description: Place the Lightning Jars in locations around Fort Barnacles. Talk to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: I'm glad you asked! Thanks to your combat prowess and my ingenuity, we have literally captured lightning in a bottle. The Lost are about to get quite a shock!
In Progress Response: Those jars aren't going to test themselves. They need to be around a high concentration of Lost.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well? Did the lightning traps perform according to expectations? I do hope it was an electrifying experience!

Title: Animal Instincts
Description: Gather samples from wildcats and alligators and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he can study how to tame them.
Objective Proposal Response: I'm an animal empath. I can intuit their thoughts and feelings. But sometimes I need more... sometimes I need parts of the animals to understand them.
In Progress Response: Nature is beautiful, and can be distracting, but you need to stay focused. Remember the goal - seek out wildcats and alligators!
Destination Completion Available Respons: These are perfect. Can you imagine having a tame wildcat helping you hunt? Or an alligator keeping the Lost away from your home?

Title: Snaggletooth
Description: Collect a tooth from a fierce lion and bring it to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
Objective Proposal Response: A lion named Snaggletooth. Seek out his den and return with his legendary fangs. Soon we will be one step closer to taming these magnificent beasts.
In Progress Response: To catch a lion you need to emulate it - be courageous and boldly go forth to seek it out!
Destination Completion Available Respons: This is a very large fang, even among adult lions. I will take some time to study it closely. In the meantime, I have news regarding your previous task.

Title: Catnipping
Description: Gather whiskers from island pumas and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
Objective Proposal Response: I've had trouble communicating with the native pumas. If you bring me some of their whiskers, I might be able to attune myself to their thoughts and feelings.
In Progress Response: Now is no time to behave like a cat! You need to get out there and collect some whiskers from the island pumas!
Destination Completion Available Respons: These whiskers should do nicely. I can already feel myself connecting with the spirits of the pumas. I feel we're making progress, but something is yet missing.

Title: Taming the Lionhearted
Description: Gather collars and leashes from tamed dogs and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
Objective Proposal Response: Lost Pirates! Have you seen the guard dogs they keep at Fort Barnacles? I must have you investigate and report back. There's so much we can learn from them!
In Progress Response: I'd stay away from the Lost too - but those at Fort Barnacles have the knowledge I seek! I must have those collars and leashes!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hmm... I do sense powerful magic within these restraints. Something dark... almost... sinister.

Title: Perfect Companion
Description: Gather boar bristles and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he may tame the ultimate pet!
Objective Proposal Response: I shall cut to the chase then. It's a boar! I simply must tame a wild boar. I just need you to slay a few of them first and bring me their bristles.
In Progress Response: Please find some boar bristles so I can be sure I want one as a pet.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Just feeling these delicate bristles between my fingers brings me a sense of profound joy. I am confident that a boar is the right choice.

Title: A Disturbing Silence
Description: Search for Jocelyn at Castaway's Colony. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: We had an argument. She wasn't happy with my being away so often for work. Said she was going to find somewhere else to live... that was some time ago.
In Progress Response: Chatting with you is filling the silence, but I long to hear my wife's voice again. Seek Jocelyn out at Castaway Colony.
Destination Completion Available Respons: There were no signs of Jocelyn? I was certain she'd be there... multiple people from town saw her heading up there.

Title: Tracking by Teeth
Description: Track Jocelyn by finding her teeth in River's Crossing. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: They're from River's Crossing. You'll find it just to the west. I'm certain that she must be over there right now, just chatting away with her kinfolk.
In Progress Response: If only I hadn't gone to help map the swamps in Reekwater. Have you found my wife, or her teeth? River's Crossing is a good place to start looking.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So, this is all you could find? No signs of Jocelyn? These teeth are unmistakable, definitely hers... where did you find them? All in one place?

Title: Heart of the Marsh
Description: Find Jocelyn and recover a keepsake from her. Talk to Swamp Walker Nekumanesh in Cutlass Keys when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: I do recall someone telling me that they found Jocelyn's trunk and many of her belongings in the marsh near the fishery. She must be there after all!
In Progress Response: Go on, she doesn't bite, at least, not anymore without her teeth. You'll find Jocelyn at River's Crossing.
Destination Completion Available Respons: What's this? Jocelyn's diary? It looks thick enough to be a memoir! Did she give you the diary to bring back to me?

Title: Treasure Island
Description: Follow the treasure map Claire provided to discover great riches! Talk to Claire Fergus in Cutlass Keys when the task is done.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes! But that’s where my problems begin; it’s only half a map, unfortunately. It points directly to the Cursed Steps, but I can’t seem to find anything there!
In Progress Response: This is all a bit exciting, isn’t it? I just wish my last partner hadn’t stolen the other half of the map. At least this half has the ‘x’ that marks the spot!
Destination Completion Available Respons: That’s it, just a handful of doubloons?! Where's the rest of the treasure? Where are the gems, the piles of gold, the chests of riches I was promised?

Title: Admiral Blackpowder's Fall (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition. Gather the chronicles of the infamous Admiral Blackpowder, and take him down for Wally Widdershins.
Objective Proposal Response: Hah! Caught your ear, though, didn't I? Same as the Admiral, feeding us golden lies about mysterious treasure on a magic island.
In Progress Response: Blackpowder... cruelest man in all the seas, and crueler still with that idol. Soon as you've stamped him into the ground, I'm walking the straight and narrow.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hah! I heard them cannons roaring! You gave ole Blackpowder a taste of his own medicine, eh? No less than the bastard deserved.

Title: Mysteries of the Deep (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to disrupt the work of a suspected Water Elemental for Rowan Pennbrook.
Objective Proposal Response: Can you imagine? A whole region of Aeternum under water. Of course I can't prove it, but... I did track a Water Elemental to this very lair. Hopefully those pirate fools haven't reached the Elemental's sanctum, though I suspect it is very deep within the caverns.
In Progress Response: In my heyday, I hunted all kinds of Elementals across Aeternum. Rare beasts, sent by the Angry Earth to guard all the island's secrets from human eyes. Gah! Just talking about it gets my blood pumping!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You say she was called a 'Nereid?' Fascinating, fascinating! Even if this Nereid said nothing about an underwater city, she must have come from somewhere, and come here for some purpose. Now to find out what it was…

Title: Cleansing Treasure (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to collect golden trinkets from the crewmembers. Bring them back to Quiggley Quorus to cleanse and sell them.
Objective Proposal Response: Aye. I was a holy man once upon a time, but no more, no more. Poverty and celibacy? What a terrible bore!
In Progress Response: I've nothing but holy water and wits! You'll fight and bring me the baubles and bits!
Destination Completion Available Respons: I've a buyer in mind, but first I must pay you in kind. Take your reward, take your coin, and hurry back for more to purloin!

Title: Cleansing Treasure (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Barnacles and Black Powder Expedition to collect golden trinkets from the crewmembers. Bring them back to Quiggley Quorus to cleanse and sell them.
Objective Proposal Response: Aye. I was a holy man once upon a time, but no more, no more. Poverty and celibacy? What a terrible bore!
In Progress Response: I've nothing but holy water and wits! You'll fight and bring me the baubles and bits!
Destination Completion Available Respons: I've a buyer in mind, but first I must pay you in kind. Take your reward, take your coin, and hurry back for more to purloin!

Title: Out of the Frying Pan
Description: Return the set of pots and pans to Cook Swampy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: It’s probably the same delinquents from Spire Rock Fort. I admire their taste in cookware, but those are family heirlooms.
In Progress Response: Any luck finding my pots and pans? I can’t believe they found my secret compartment under the rug. Uh oh…
Destination Completion Available Respons: You brought my pans! Thanks again. I'll cook you up an old Swampy special... on the house of course!

Title: Relics of the Tower
Description: Loot relics from chests inside Crow's Nest Lighthouse. Talk to Quartermaster Duffy in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when your task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: But of course! There's always loot to be found if one looks in the right place, and Malocchio Spire is surely the right place!
In Progress Response: Ahoy! Do you have the booty?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Your plundering has brought welcome disrepute to our fine, pirate town! Well done!

Title: Explosive Prospecting
Description: Investigate the source of the tremors in the Highpass Mining Camp and defuse the situation. Talk to Captain Lucian in Spyglass Ridge when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: If you would be so kind. We would prefer to keep the mountain, and our town for that matter, intact.
In Progress Response: Show those Lost brigands that we will not stand idly by while they threaten our town.
Destination Completion Available Respons: That should deter those greedy bastards for some time. Thanks.

Title: Lightning in a Bottle
Description: Find elemental materials from spirits and bring them back to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: The work order is requesting the necessary resources for more bottled lightning. Bring the resources, take a doubloon. Honor system of course.
In Progress Response: The box sits, silent, waiting for goods.
Destination Completion Available Respons: No doubt Fei Lixin is grateful, and you're now a bit richer.

Title: Lightning Unleashed
Description: Place the Lightning Jars in locations around Fort Barnacles. Talk to Artificer Fei in the Cutlass Keys Settlement when the task is complete.
Objective Proposal Response: Several, actually. Mostly minor tweaks, but enough to warrant further testing. Head back to Fort Ramos and deploy them in the same way as before!
In Progress Response: Those jars aren't going to test themselves. They need to be around a high concentration of Lost.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, excellent work as always! But innovation requires iteration, as they say, so please return soon for the next round of testing.

Title: Animal Instincts
Description: Gather samples from wildcats and alligators and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he can study how to tame them.
Objective Proposal Response: I’m so glad you found one of my collecting stations! Since you’re here, why not help me out a trifle? I am in need of both wildcat claws and alligator scales.
In Progress Response: Nature is beautiful, and can be distracting, but you need to stay focused. This collecting station won't fill itself!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Tosch is sure to find these samples useful, just as he's sure to not miss this doubloon he so graciously left lying here.

Title: Snaggletooth
Description: Collect a tooth from a fierce lion and bring it to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
Objective Proposal Response: Excellent work, locating another of my collecting stations! I could do with more Snaggleteeth, drop one off here and take some coin for your trouble.
In Progress Response: It would be much simpler to take the reward left here by Tosch, but something resembling a conscience is keeping you from this act of blatant thievery.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You drop a tooth into the box and hear it clatter against numerous other teeth. It sounds distressingly similar to the coin you drop in your purse.

Title: Catnipping
Description: Gather whiskers from island pumas and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
Objective Proposal Response: Good on you, finding my collecting station! Had to hide it so bandits stopped stealing from it. I could use more island puma whiskers, for a reward of course.
In Progress Response: This station is still empty and sad, bring back some puma whiskers to make it filled and glad!
Destination Completion Available Respons: "How many whiskers can one man need?" The question plagues your mind as you set them in the designated basket.

Title: Taming the Lionhearted
Description: Gather collars and leashes from tamed dogs and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys.
Objective Proposal Response: This is bittersweet, you've found the last of my collecting stations! Gather more of those evil harnesses and bring them here so I may destroy them.
In Progress Response: Standing before Tosch's final collecting station makes your heart hurt. You steel yourself before the work ahead.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You stuff the leather straps into the box with some effort. All that work deserves a reward, and Tosch has graciously provided.

Title: Perfect Companion
Description: Gather boar bristles and bring them to Tosch in Cutlass Keys so he may tame the ultimate pet!
Objective Proposal Response: Ah, I was so lost in thought I didn't see you there! I’ve been using boar’s hair wherever I can, embracing the essence of boar. Could you get more for me?
In Progress Response: You don't want to hear another boar pun do you? I promise it won't be pretty! Get going before I think up another ab-boar-rent joke!
Destination Completion Available Respons: My joy in receiving these boar bristles has yet to diminish, nor has my gratitude to you for delivering them to me!

Title: Treasure Island
Description: Follow the treasure map Claire provided to discover great riches! Talk to Claire Fergus in Cutlass Keys when the task is done.
Objective Proposal Response: There must be! I refuse to believe that traitor I once called a partner was able to best me in my treasure hunt. Get back out there and find whatever you can!
In Progress Response: Look, I'm flattered, but what are you doing coming back here and talkin' my ear off? It's not a courtship I'm looking for, it's treasure!
Destination Completion Available Respons: By the Kracken, is that really all that was left? This really is looking dire… Maybe if we wait a bit longer, something will turn up?

Title: Death and Duty
Description: Defeat the former Watcher Antonio Guerra, find any scouting reports at his camp, and put his soul to rest. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in the Mourningdale Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Is that so? Well you certainly look capable enough, and I’m in no position to turn away an able body.
In Progress Response: Time is of the essence, friend. The Corrupted are gathering strength, and who knows what other forces array against us. Hurry!
Destination Completion Available Respons: So… this is it then? Antonio… lost to us. I suppose once this is all over, I will have eternity to mourn his loss.

Title: Tears in Rain
Description: Defeat Spirits at Stephen's Claim to Collect Teardrop Gems. Then report back to Artificer Wrightson in the Mourningdale Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Money. What else? I’m aware of how foolish it sounds, but I once had a lot invested in this place, and I can’t just leave empty-handed.
In Progress Response: Scared of ghosts, stranger? Can’t say I blame you. But there’s no reward without risk!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well, aren’t you a marvel. I’ve been trying to get my hands on these gems since I first set foot in Mourningdale. They should fetch us a king's bounty.

Title: Silver Tongue, Golden Coins
Description: Recover the gold medallions from Padre Nuñez at his Mansion. Then report back to Artificer Wrightson in the Mourningdale Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: You're clearly not afraid of a few Lost. And, in this case, you’ll be doing the world a favor. Who doesn’t love an altruist?
In Progress Response: Just one more errand and we’ll have all the money we need to make ourselves scarce.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I think you’re my new best friend! Not only did you deliver the goods, but you punished that old snake Nunez.

Title: Hearth and Home
Description: Clear Weeper enemies from Porridgepot. Then report back to Constable Bayles in the Mourningdale Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: You’re a true friend. A man’s home is his castle, but my first duty is to the citizens here. Keeping them safe is the priority.
In Progress Response: Is something keeping you, friend? I’m eager to learn what’s become of my home in my absence.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You’re back? How fares my estate? Tell me it's not overrun with the Lost…

Title: Lost in the Flood
Description: Investigate the ruins in the Flooded Plains, and return found artifacts to Gildon in Mourningdale.
Objective Proposal Response: Probably not. The visions do not lie. But are they omens of the future or mere echoes of the past? I cannot be certain…
In Progress Response: I must find my center, stranger. Without a center, there is only chaos and imbalance. Help me!
Destination Completion Available Respons: What you carry has brought clarity across time and space, stranger. These are artifacts from a lost age, but also omens of coming strife.

Title: The Broken Road
Description: Defeat Novaguard foot soldiers in the lookouts along the Ancient Road, and give their armor scraps to Gildon in Mourningdale.
Objective Proposal Response: I must see more. The Guardians are the ones who once did battle with our insolent foe. They employed protections we might yet recover.
In Progress Response: My vision remains hazy, stranger. Bring me what I need, or I fear history may repeat itself…
Destination Completion Available Respons: Yes. Yes! I can see it now, blood and flame and the roiling red wrath of the Corruption, scourging its way across the land!

Title: Look Back in Anger
Description: Defeat Fineseer foot soldiers while climbing to the top of Vela, and show its treasure to Gildon in Mourningdale.
Objective Proposal Response: A Watchtower, ancient and powerful, is your next destination. Vela. Your quarry stands proud and tall upon its peak.
In Progress Response: The Watchers in the Tower… against what did they stand guard? Is it the same now as it was then?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Yes! Can you feel it, stranger? This is the moment. When I gaze through this glass, I look back across the ages to the time of… Ah!

Title: Misfortunes Multiply
Description: Defeat Musslebeard and the Seasong pirates in his charge. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in Mourningdale.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, of course. Our scouts. Antonio's notes say the pirates found themselves a new leader. A brute they call Musslebeard.
In Progress Response: Hurry, friend. Musslebeard must be defeated. We can’t afford any distractions.
Destination Completion Available Respons: It’s done then? Musslebeard is destroyed and my Antonio avenged? Good. There is some solace in that.

Title: Corruption's Call
Description: Defeat the Redeyes and destroy Spewspitter's emblem in New Balefire, then return to Gildon in Mourningdale.
Objective Proposal Response: An Ancient Lighthouse by the sea, calling like a siren. I believe the place is called “Bahia”. There is a totem there, screaming at its heart.
In Progress Response: The scream still echoes through the souls of our neighbors, stranger. Make haste. No more may fall into the Corruption’s grip.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The fog has lifted from my eyes. The blur of past, present - all run together - no longer haunts my waking hours. There is clarity, but also still questions.

Title: Best Laid Plans
Description: Investigate key locations to the north that have been taken by the Wardogs. Then report back to Magistrate Wallace in Mourningdale.
Objective Proposal Response: One faction of Corrupted known as the Wardogs, they gather their forces up north. Make no mistake. They formulate strategy to march on us here in Grayvale.
In Progress Response: Fortune favors the prepared, friend. If we’re going to stop the Corrupted, we need to know precisely what they’re planning.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Aha! Ore from the mines and maps plotting the Corrupted’s movements. It seems like they’ve stopped to equip themselves for a long fight.

Title: When it Rains, it Pours
Description: The Mourningdale settlement has been struck by tragedy and is in disarray. Constable Bayles will fill you in.
Objective Proposal Response: Disaster on top of disaster. The northern settlements have fallen, and a steady flow of refugees has us spread increasingly thin.
In Progress Response: If you want to help us, speak to Fletcher. She'll know all the latest developments.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The Constable sent you? I’m not sure what we can do. Magistrate Wallace is being completely irrational, won't do a thing until she gets news about Antonio.

Title: Ode to Aeternum
Description: Pierre Auguste would like new tales of Aeternum, but is too timid to travel himself. Write a collection of odes to the scenic locations described in Pierre's guidebook.
Objective Proposal Response: That's what I'm told. I even bought a guidebook! I admit though, I'm a coward. Quelle folie... It must be frightful to die.
In Progress Response: Have you visited the places in my guidebook?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, you're back! I'm burning with anticipation to read your contributions! Leilani's stories are wonderful, but she's retired. I yearn for new tales!

Title: Stone Cold Secrets
Description: Follow Leilani's clues, written on your map, to complete her last adventure and find three lost artifacts of Ancient construction.
Objective Proposal Response: I finally encountered a cliff I could not climb. Old age. I can't fight like I used to and my bones ache more each day. My adventuring days are pau.
In Progress Response: Are you taking a rest? In-between tasks? Do let me know if you've found whatever secrets are locked inside those monuments.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well, look at this, Pierre! Our adventurer returns!

Title: The Last Mystery
Description: Travel to three locations marked on your map and investigate whether Leilani's key can be used at each.
Objective Proposal Response: They fit together into a larger artifact. It's got markings that I believe correspond to some Ancient sites I visited in my adventuring days.
In Progress Response: Have you tested that artifact yet? I'm sure it all means something. What mysteries still lie hidden out there?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Look, Pierre! Our stalwart returns! Tell us, was it a key? What mysteries did it unlock?

Title: A Toast to Adventure
Description: Bring Leilani's Special Order to the Bartender in the Mourningdale Tavern.
Objective Proposal Response: Ae! A toast to adventure. Faced with adversity, you still rise to the occasion. Reminds me of myself, when I was young and wild.
In Progress Response: Hurry up and bring my order to the bartender, then! Don't hang about!
Destination Completion Available Respons: What's this? Another order from that woman upstairs? I thought I just saw her friend leaving…

Title: Amateur Adventurer
Description: Follow the trail of clues to find where Pierre has gone.
Objective Proposal Response: My friends! Your stories of valor and verve have inspired me! Soon I will be back to regale you with tales of my own adventure to the north!
In Progress Response: This is the note left by Pierre when he set out for adventure.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh thank the heavens, it's you! I've been stuck here for days! C’est la galère!

Title: Song of the Sea
Description: Find the Captain's lost Shanty Book and Hurdy-Gurdy.
Objective Proposal Response: Nothing like that. This be a tragic tale. Music’s me soul, y'see. But me crewmates never fancied me shanties.
In Progress Response: I don't feel like meself these days. Me music be the only thing left to cling to out here.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Dancing dolphins! Me hurdy-gurdy! Ye've found her! An' me shanties as well! I don't know how I could repay ye.

Title: Village Champion
Description: Recover Lerato's Heirloom armor and sword from the Corrupted in Ceremony and return them to her at the crossroads.
Objective Proposal Response: Who else? My father was our town's defender. He died fighting, and the Corrupted took his weapon and his armor.
In Progress Response: My father fought them in the streets, but for every one he struck down, five more would take their place.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You're back! And with my father's armor as well! I'd recognize it anywhere! You've done me and my father a great kindness.

Title: Malign Dominion
Description: Find and destroy Malign Nodes at each of three Corrupt checkpoints along the road, then return to Harunobu at the crossroads. Some of these nodes are out of reach, you may need to bring a ranged weapon.
Objective Proposal Response: They must be! I may be just a hog farmer from Hibbotsfeld, but I recognize purpose when I see it!
In Progress Response: Ah! Stay back! Oh, it's you again. Have you seen what those Corrupted are up to on the roads?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Yah! You have got to stop startling me like that! Did you see what those Corrupted are doing? Did you destroy their Malign Nodes?

Title: Makin' Bacon
Description: Harvest Mourning Pigs in Hibbotsfeld for Harunobu and return them to him at the crossroads.
Objective Proposal Response: Hogs! I'm a hog farmer. Always have been. I've got nothing left now! If only I had a way to get some of my precious pork…
In Progress Response: Well? Did you go to my farm? I'd do it myself, but I'm just a hog farmer.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh, that's Hibbotsfeld pork if I've ever seen it. Look at that marbling!

Title: Soul Music
Description: Clear away the Withered around the Ancient Head so that Jan Jaansen can better hear the mysterious voice.
Objective Proposal Response: Are you sure? It's right there, playing at the edge of my hearing.
In Progress Response: I almost had it for a moment! If only those Withered were driven away… It's something like a poem…
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh, I heard it! For but a moment it was clear as the dawn! A song of epic proportions, a song of…

Title: Following the Bard's Song
Description: Search the coastal roads for Jan Jaansen
Objective Proposal Response: Thanks for the inspiration! Here's to the brave soul that helped me to find my way on the roads north of the Settlement!
In Progress Response: (Jan Jaansen wrote this note.)
Destination Completion Available Respons: It's as though you heard me calling for you from so far away.

Title: New Perspective
Description: Get to the end of Presage Pier and look for inspiration for the next stanza of Jan's epic.
Objective Proposal Response: Worthy of ballads, I'm sure! Care to take on another task for me? The muse compels…
In Progress Response: It all started with that voice, the one in the Ancient Head. Are you sure you couldn't hear it?
Destination Completion Available Respons: You are indeed a heroic sort, aren't you? Tell me then, what did you find?

Title: Harmonic Resonance
Description: Follow Jan Jaansen's inspiration to the location foretold in Jan's inspiration.
Objective Proposal Response: But it's in the air, it's all around us! I can hear it ringing. It's telling me that the secret is at The Lighthouse.
In Progress Response: (Jan seems lost in her thoughts. She hums a haunting tune.)
Destination Completion Available Respons: (The Ancient Sculpture instills a compulsion to reach towards its surface. As if the merest touch would reveal a cosmic sense of music. A wordless vision of vastness, and of escape.)

Title: Welcome to Mourningdale
Description: Find Harunobu, recently of Hibbotsfeld.
Objective Proposal Response: So I've heard. More and more people falling through here lost their livelihoods. Some lost worse!
In Progress Response: Have you checked in with those newcomers yet? Don't want them feeling left out after all that's happened to them.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hey, it's {PlayerName}! Great to see you again. Want to try some of this pork? The facilities here are top-notch!

Title: The People in the Neighborhood
Description: Bring a sample of Harunobu's roast pork to Lerato.
Objective Proposal Response: I was at the brink of despair for a time there. But, that woman from the crossroads, Lerato? She was kind enough to travel here with me.
In Progress Response: Hey {PlayerName}! Get that meat to Lerato while it's still hot!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh hello, what have you brought me? Ah, bless that Harunobu, he is so kind to me.

Title: Seasoned Adventurer
Description: Race Pierre home to the Mourningdale Settlement
Objective Proposal Response: I intend to! I'll just take a moment to catch my breath, then I'll make haste back to my nice warm stool. Let's make a race of it! Bet I get back before you!
In Progress Response: I've just tightened up my laces and checked my pockets. I'll be ready for the road soon. What will Leilani think of us when we get back and share our tale?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well, well! You made it back! I thought you might have been faster than me, but here we are! Those bluish shrines really make travel convenient, non?

Welcome to Prydwen
Description: Check in at the Regent's Rise Inn, and keep an eye out for the pirate captain from the beach, Grace O'Malley.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Why nothing less thrilling than the return of the 'True Heir'! Ser Gawain is coming home after centuries to finally claim the throne of High King Artorius!
In Progress Response: <g id="female_lookaroundShifty" priority="high" />It's a long day at this post with no relief. If someone doesn't show up soon, I'm afraid <g id="female_nodyes" />I'll have to go off into the bushes for a minute or two.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="grace_cajole" priority="high"/>Now there's a familiar face! About time you caught up.

Title: Friends with Coin
Description: Grace O'Malley has given you the coin she owes you. Look for bargains at the Trading Post and store the excess at the Storage Shed.

Objective Proposal Response: I tried to guide the people towards their faith, by giving them something tangible to focus on.
In Progress Response: The journals of Dayo Musa should really be discussed with him.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hello, friend! I hope this day is treating you with kindness.

Title: The Aspiring Knight
Description: Ashe Dubois, Ser Payne's squire, has always longed to be a knight. Give her the proof that someone in her family used to be a knight once.
Objective Proposal Response: The helm, the bow, and the crest of Margot will mark the Dubois family history.
In Progress Response: The proclamation concerning the Dubois Family Crest should should be taken to Ashe Dubois.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Really? You found something that belonged to my family! What is it? Who are they? Where can I meet them?

Title: Devil Honey
Description: Get combs of Devil's Honey from Geertie Lother's private reserve at Hiraeth Lookout and return them to her in Prydwen.
Objective Proposal Response: They say you've been quite a help, and I was like, "Well, why haven't they helped me?"
In Progress Response: You’ll find the honeycombs at Hiraeth Lookout. Just wait until you taste this honey!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Aha! There's my honey! Er, I mean my honeycombs. I wasn't calling you "my honey." That would be... absurd.

Title: Old World Wine
Description: Celebrate while you still can. Collect jars of Old World wine from Brysedd Shore and share them with Geertie Lother.
Objective Proposal Response: Seeing as how everyone is talking about "battening down the hatches" here to protect against the Lost, I think we need to stock up on spirits.
In Progress Response: Stars above! The Old World wine from Brysedd Shore! I can't wait. Pirates sure have all the best stuff!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh yeah, I can feel the party coming on already! We got wine and honeycakes - it's gonna be a feast!

Title: Resources for Prydwen
Description: Collect Stone, Wood and Leather for Cemal Qadir, Prydwen's Master Builder, so that he can build good defenses for Prydwen.
Objective Proposal Response: Well, I've run into some supply troubles. I was expecting a shipment of stone, timber, and leather this week.
In Progress Response: Did you get everything? Not one hair of leather should be missing. Every resource counts towards fortifying Prydwen’s defenses.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Great! You brought exactly what I needed, the right type and the right amount. Were you always this resourceful?

Title: A Sword for a Friend
Description: Cemal Qadir is very happy with the work you've done and wants to do something for you in turn. Learn how to build a sword with his guidance.
Objective Proposal Response: Words to live by, rajal sadaq! You could be knight material and I want to see you make it through a few more summers, at least.
In Progress Response: Craft me the best sword you can! I want to see what you’re capable of!
Destination Completion Available Respons: That's a fine-looking sword, rajal sadaq. It would almost rival the swords in Syria.

Title: The Town Project Board
Description: Visit the Town Project Board of Monarch's Bluffs and find tasks to help the people of the settlement.

Title: Down Payment
Description: Track down the workers who betrayed Giacomo
Objective Proposal Response: A place of rest for weary travelers, of course! I am Giacomo Altoviti, architect. Perhaps you have heard of me? No?
In Progress Response: Your aid is welcome, friend. Once we have my notebook, I have such plans. It will change all of Aeternum! And you will be greatly rewarded, fear not!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Is that my notebook? Oh, grazie! And what of those bastardi who stabbed me and stole it?

Description: Track down the workers who betrayed Giacomo
Objective Proposal Response: 1225_0101_downpayment_proposal
In Progress Response: Your aid is welcome, friend. Once we have my notebook, I have such plans. It will change all of Aeternum! And you will be greatly rewarded, fear not!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Is that my notebook? Oh, grazie! And what of those bastardi who stabbed me and stole it?
