In Progress Response: Your aid is welcome, friend. Once we have my notebook, I have such plans. It will change all of Aeternum! And you will be greatly rewarded, fear not!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Is that my notebook? Oh, grazie! And what of those bastardi who stabbed me and stole it?

Title: A Major Purchase
Description: Purchase a home, and place some decorations within
Objective Proposal Response: It is sanctuary! A haven that beckons after a long day. It anchors you to the land. And spirit shrines can deposit you gently inside from anywhere on the island!
In Progress Response: Raising the capital for your first home may not be easy, but I promise you, the benefits are worthwhile.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Good friend, you have returned! And looking stronger and more prosperous than before. You have made your purchase, yes?

Title: Insuring the Investment
Description: Travel to Shatterwall and the Fong Family Orchard to collect fresh Withered blood and bones for Giacomo
Objective Proposal Response: Eh, of a sort. I have selected the site to prepare the foundation, but I'll need a few things.
In Progress Response: To be honest, I'm not entirely certain how the bones and blood will work, but my Survivalist friend swears by it. I figured better safe than sorry, no?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Welcome to the site of the first Traveler's Rest! It may not seem much right now, but I promise you... it will be! Now, have you gathered those grisly bits I needed?

Title: Insuring the Investment (Part 2)
Description: Gather Grave Nettles from Nettlerest Graveyard, and bring them back to Giacomo
Objective Proposal Response: Si, a plant that grows on and around gravesites. Some people still go through the ceremony for those who have become Lost.
In Progress Response: Scuse, I do not mean to impose on you, but I am certain that when you see the result, you will be amazed.
Destination Completion Available Respons: See my accomplishment? Amazing progress, no? The foundation is almost finished.

Title: Site Inspection
Description: Gather the construction materials for Giacomo, and investigate the information on the next traitor
Objective Proposal Response: Si, si! I'm also running short of materials. I had planned this project with a work crew behind me, but we saw how that turned out.
In Progress Response: I've almost exhausted my stockpile. But I have confidence you'll handle matters swiftly, and return with good news and packs of supplies!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Magnifico! Now, travelers have a haven from the dangers and horrors of this island. This is my dream: a home for all who need it.

Title: Mandatory Improvements
Description: Collect the materials for Giacomo's recipe, then craft the Ancient Protection Stones at an Arcane Repository
Objective Proposal Response: Listen carefully - I've rediscovered how the Ancients protected some of their sites. Ah! Ah!
In Progress Response: Because I am cautious, there are a few steps not in that recipe that I'll keep secret… at least for now. But in time, I'll share my knowledge. But not for a profit!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Bentornato! And just in time! This road is well-traveled. I've had my hands full keeping the less friendly sorts away.

Title: Closing Cost
Description: Track down Airic Niclisson, the leader of those who betrayed Giacomo
Objective Proposal Response: Si, Airic Niclisson, the foreman of my treacherous crew. I'm certain he was the mastermind of their scheme.
In Progress Response: Just preparing for the road, then I'm on my way. I hope to find Airic myself. But I'm uncertain what to do then.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Friend! Any news? You found him! What did that scoundrel say when faceded with his crimes? E fatta. He got what he deserved.

Title: Desire For A Child
Description: Primrose has asked you to find her darling daughter, Hazel. Your search starts at her childhood home in Hakenstadt.
Objective Proposal Response: Hakenstadt. It's where Hazel grew up, where she said "mama" for the first time. Have you ever experienced a child's first word? It's utterly delightful!
In Progress Response: Any word on my Hazel? She's a tall, smiling brunette with dancing eyes. Always happy, no matter what challenge comes her way.
Destination Completion Available Respons: What did you find in Hakenstadt? I miss that place. My husband and I taught Hazel to sew there. She loved making little dresses for her dolls.

Title: The Truth Behind Transmutations
Description: Hazel has been experimenting with forbidden life magic. Continue your search further east in Krummholm.
Objective Proposal Response: My poor girl! I knew she longed to experience motherhood. I'd speak often of the joy I felt carrying her, feeling her grow inside me.
In Progress Response: Any news on my Hazel? I've been worried sick. I couldn't bear losing her as well. She's the sunshine of my soul.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You're back! What news of Hazel? Wait. What do you mean she wasn't at Krummholm?

Title: The Hope Of The Living
Description: Primrose fears what her daughter may have done. Find Hazel and bring her safely back home.
Objective Proposal Response: I only sought to comfort her. And she knows this island can be cruel. I love my Hazel, the woman she's become. She's brave and beautiful.
In Progress Response: Please find Hazel and tell her to come back home. Tell her the two of us are enough. We have to be.
Destination Completion Available Respons: No! Hazel! Why did you do this to yourself? This is my fault… I drove her to this…

Title: Starting the Fire
Description: Gather strange torches from Richmire region and bring them to Torchy Cabrera in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: Ah well, if you have not heard anything, then perhaps it is best we keep it that way.
In Progress Response: Be on the lookout for the strange, ghostly torches. And try not to get burned too badly.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh, yes. Don't you see? The light, the color… it is truly beautiful.

Title: Burning from the Inside
Description: Collect Perpetual Illumination Essences from Ancients at Aqua Acadia and bring them to Torchy Cabrera in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: I believe the Ancients knew the secrets of Eternal Fire and Eternal Light as well.
In Progress Response: Amid the ruins of Aqua Acadia to the north, you will see for yourself.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Perfect… perfect! This illumination essence is the missing link!

Title: Hellfire & Brimstone Oven
Description: Travel to Navarro's Kitchen and defeat Chef Navarro and collect "Navarro's Flaming Duck Recipe". Then bring it to Torchy in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: You must help me clear my name so I can go home. You see, I was exiled from the settlement for starting a fire…
In Progress Response: Chef Navarro's Kitchen is not far, and I feel certain he still carries his "Flaming Duck Recipe."
Destination Completion Available Respons: He still had it, didn't he? Yes… yes! This proves that HE was the one who started the fire!

Title: Denying The Denier
Description: Travel to Periville, slay the Denier, and bring proof of its demise to Evelyn Van Heck in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: I expected as much. Blast.
In Progress Response: Just so we're clear, I am not responsible if The Denier kills you as well.
Destination Completion Available Respons: He was once our brother. Alas, this terrible fate so often awaits the Crone's many victims. Here. Your bounty, as promised.

Title: Keeping the Faith
Description: Travel to Periville and find Joan and Markus. Report back to Evelyn Van Heck in Weaver's Fen with news of their fate.
Objective Proposal Response: Unfortunately, I must assume the worst. Joan and Markus had only recently joined our hunt. It's possible they lacked the fortitude to withstand such a harrowing death.
In Progress Response: Hope for the best, prepare for… well, I would rather not think about that.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I am at a loss for words, traveler. This emblem was a bond of brotherhood. It is a symbol of our commitment to the hunt.

Title: A Well-Earned Respite
Description: Travel to Karburg, slay Ruiz Velazquez, and bring proof of his demise to Evelyn Van Heck in Weaver's Fen.
Player Prompt: “Do you want me to find him, too?”
Objective Proposal Response: You have already risked so much. It pains me to ask for your aid again.
In Progress Response: I pray I am wrong. I do not think I am, but I must cling to hope. Too much despair and we lose ourselves. Just like they did.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Am I truly all that remains? Ruiz and I had such plans. We intended to hunt terrors in the shadow lands of Durevos.

Title: Gators Gone Wild
Description: Collect alligator scales from Gators in Weaver's Fen and return them to Hunter Samuel in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: A hunt, of course! You and I shall venture forth into the marshes in pursuit of the most ferocious, cunning, and formidable beasts this festering land has to offer!
In Progress Response: I shall make my own way into the stinking bog. You go on ahead. I suspect you will need the head start, after all.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, you have returned! I was beginning to wonder. Now, let me see your trophies.

Title: No Mere Pigs
Description: Collect boar tusks from Polder Boars in Weaver's Fen and return them to Hunter Samuel just north of the settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Boars! No ordinary boars, but boars the size of three men! We will not waste our skill on mere pigs!
In Progress Response: Ah, yes, I shall be along promptly! Uh, once I have finished oiling my musket, of course.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The prodigal hunter returns! You truly are a fellow after my own heart. Let us see your fine trophies. Hand them over, I say!

Title: The True Contest
Description: Collect wolf paws from Mallory Wolves, found north of Fenton's Hamlet, and return them to Hunter Samuel in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: How can you have won if there has been no contest? Nay, we shall have to settle this once and for all.
In Progress Response: I relish the end of our contest. Go on. I am right behind you!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You are simply not going to believe this. My musket was ready, my boots laced, my satchel patched, and a COURIER found me on the road! There was urgent business in the hamlet to attend to.

Title: Stalk of Shame
Description: Defeat the Werna Packleader at Dusty Paw Burrow, far to the north and west of Weaver’s Fen Hamlet, and collect a trophy from your kill for Hunter Samuel in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: Do you know what it's like, being saddled with a legacy like mine? Why, if people only knew how incompetent I really am, my family name would be utterly ruined.
In Progress Response: I will not pretend that this arrangement pleases me, my friend, but I am grateful that you have chosen to take pity on me.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, well, there it is. She was enormous, wasn’t she? I, uh, I wish I could have seen it myself.

Title: Story of the Stones
Description: Gather stone samples from rubble in the nearby ruins. Then report back to Architect Na Li in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, exactly! These stones have been here as long as anyone can remember. If we can learn how the Ancient architects reinforced these structures, imagine what WE could accomplish!
In Progress Response: Do you have those stone samples for me? They are vital to my research.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Look at this beautiful basalt you’ve brought me. I wonder where the Ancients sourced it from?

Title: Spanning the Ages
Description: Gather stone samples from rubble at South Vega Bridge. Then report back to Architect Na Li in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: I need another sample from a newer site to be certain. Master Ting Long once theorized that the bridge that spans the marshes was built in a more recent era.
In Progress Response: I hope to have answers for us soon, my friend. And if I am right, then we might see some NEW wonders in Aeternum.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Great, you’re back. Let’s take a look at these new samples you've found. Interesting… these are less weathered, but only just. Fascinating.

Title: Deep Time
Description: Gather stone samples from rubble at Andrometus. Then report back to Architect Na Li in Weaver's Fen.
Player Prompt: "Are the Ancients are also that old?”
Objective Proposal Response: It does, doesn’t it? So many questions, but we must resist the temptation to draw conclusions. Stone dating is far from an established field of study, after all.
In Progress Response: Let me know when you've got those Andrometus samples.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You and I will be friends, after this. Perhaps I will carve your name into the aqueducts of the future. Or would you prefer a temple? Maybe a stone garden?

Title: That Beautiful Stench
Description: Gather materials in Weaver's Fen and then visit an arcane repository to craft a perfume for Tullius Volusus in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, precisely!
In Progress Response: Can the unique fragrance of Weaver’s Fen truly be replicated by human hands? I await your return with bated breath.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hmm, yes… decadent, musky, with a sulfuric accord that resonates right through to the top notes… you’ve captured Weaver's Fen perfectly.

Title: Misplaced Treasure
Description: Search chests at North Vega Bridge for a clue to Nora’s whereabouts. Then report back to Leonie Roggeveen in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: Likewise. I was wondering if you might be able to help me?
In Progress Response: This game was much less stressful when it took place in EMPTY ruins, you see. I do hope she's alright.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You’re back! And in one piece! Do you have the clue? It could be a coin, a note, an etching…Oh, give it here. The suspense is killing me.

Title: Following Nora
Description: Search chests at Canopus for a clue to Nora’s whereabouts. Then report back to Leonie Roggeveen in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: Something about the iconography she used… It suggests half of a whole. Aha!
In Progress Response: As thrilled as I am, her long absence is truly starting to wear on me. Could you hurry with that clue? It would put me at ease to finally find her.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Another coin! Wonderful, hand it over, let’s see what she has to say…

Title: Odds in Her Favor
Description: Follow Nora's trail to Aqua Acadia and search chests for the final clue.
Objective Proposal Response: Nora thought she could stump me, did she? Me, the greatest coin collector in Aeternum? Come on, give me a tough one, ha!
In Progress Response: Hopefully we near the end of our chase, my friend. Nora can handle herself… right?
Destination Completion Available Respons: I see you found my note. Did Dr. Leonie send you?

Title: Nora, Found
Description: Return to Dr. Leonie Roggeveen in Weaver's Fen.
Objective Proposal Response: Yeah, no wonder. When those Guardians appeared, the only two things I could think about were "I'm going to die" and "Leonie will be so worried".
In Progress Response: I'll meet you and Leonie back on the road. I'll sneak out while you're distracting them.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You’re back! Nora told me everything. I am SO relieved.

Title: The Nose Knows
Description: Find someone who can make bear repellent, as a favor to Dr. Theophrastus. Then, distribute the repellent to the researchers in the field.
Objective Proposal Response: Hmm, yes, well. This has been a stimulating conversation, but I must get back to work.
In Progress Response: The phosphorus in these urine samples is elevated…it even glows in the dark. Fascinating.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh, you're back? Do you know much about urine?

Title: Hazard Pay (Expedition)
Description: Percy Ellwood is searching for valuable Ancient Artifacts from Garden of Genesis
Objective Proposal Response: Name’s Doctor Percival Ellwood. Call me Percy. I’m a collector of sorts. And you’re just the sort of folk I’ve been waiting for.
In Progress Response: Returning empty handed? Well, can’t say I blame you. Not everyone has the gumption to brave the unknown.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Smite my bones! You made it through! What did you find? I’ll sort and label everything, take them back to the institute in London once I escape this place.

Title: Parted in Anger
Description: Speak to members of the Cult of Renewal to learn what happened to Han Fang's daughter, Han Liu.
Objective Proposal Response: How embarrassing. Yes. This is all so personal, and you a total stranger, but my daughter Han Liu has vanished.
In Progress Response: I know I ask a great deal of you, stranger. You have my family's gratitude. Please bring my daughter back to me.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You return! Did they speak to you? I cannot fathom they would turn you away as well. You do not have that "hovering mother" look about you.

Title: The Cult of Renewal
Description: Find Han Liu by joining her on the Cult of Renewal's so-called "Path of Truth."
Objective Proposal Response: They would. How like a cult to both prevent me from speaking to her after she was in their clutches and then immediately send her away to prove herself.
In Progress Response: I only hope we are not too late.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I cannot tell you what a relief it is to see another on the road. I was truly beginning to worry I would need to continue on alone!

Title: Walking Wyrds
Description: Complete your own Path of Truth by planting an imbued seed at each of the Angry Earth shrines within the Wyrdwood Twists. Help Han Liu do the same by clearing the path of Angry Earth.
Objective Proposal Response: My mother? She truly cannot mind her own affairs, can she? This is MY choice. Those people were kind to me. All I want to do is learn more about them!
In Progress Response: I can climb well enough, but I am afraid I am rather useless in a fight. I hope for both our sakes that you are equipped to handle this.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Forgive me for being so cryptic before. This trial is certainly not for the faint of heart, but it does help us find those who truly think and feel as we do.

Title: Spoken Wyrds
Description: Talk to Han Fang about taking the oath to officially join the Cult of Renewal.
Objective Proposal Response: You have, but in deed only. I have seen your commitment to understanding what it is we are doing here and it has been noted.
In Progress Response: The High Sage spoke those words to me when first we met. I felt them so stark, so prescient, that I saved them for all to come.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Welcome to the Cult of Renewal, my friend. I now name you Initiate, and soon all of our knowledge will be yours.

Title: A Sword in my Stead
Description: Try to talk Han Liu out of undergoing a difficult rite and help her succeed if she insists on going anyway.
Objective Proposal Response: She mentioned yet another trial, this time to one of those dryad-infested towers! I need not remind you how utterly defenseless she is!
In Progress Response: What on Aeternum is this cult after? It feels to me as if they are trying to get their followers killed. Oh Liu… why won't you listen?
Destination Completion Available Respons: What a triumph. In so little time both you and Miss Liu have not only demonstrated a willingness to learn, but also a deep, abiding respect for the denizens of Edengrove.

Title: One of Us
Description: Venture to Buggane Hedge and harvest herbs for a calming tea from the hides of dryads.
Objective Proposal Response: Like myself and the High Sage, and the scores of Exalted, they will have gained the deepest, most complete understanding of our way of life.
In Progress Response: I find a calming tea helps center them, opens their mind to the experience they are about to have.
Destination Completion Available Respons: This is a fine bundle of herbs. I hope you did not have a great deal of trouble acquiring them- it is a tricky task at best.

Title: Something to Celebrate
Description: Venture into the verdant forests of Edengrove to harvest colorful flowers in celebration of the returning cultists.
Player Prompt: "What happens if they do not return?"
Objective Proposal Response: Ah… I would prefer not to darken the mood with that discussion. I will, but not now. In this moment I would like to assume they will succeed.
In Progress Response: I find a nice flower wreathe to heighten any bright and cheerful moment. And their return shall be so!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have a fine eye for color. Yes, these will do nicely. I will save the extras for another time, perhaps dry them. That seems appropriate.

Title: Waste Not, Want Not
Description: Retrieve the fallen belongings of cultists who have failed their final rite.
Player Prompt: "Is that it? They just… don't come back?"
Objective Proposal Response: Not as themselves, no. They likely still linger in the forest in a more… lacking state. A soulless state, one could say.
In Progress Response: Everything we do is to strengthen the cult. No one individual rises above that goal. Not even myself. Not even the High Sage.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You went into the forest? Oh, this curiosity of mine is consuming! Tell me, tell me, what did you see? What happened to them?

Title: Where You Go, I Will Follow
Description: Help Han Fang reunite with Han Liu.
Player Prompt: "I do not think she will leave them."
Objective Proposal Response: I think you are right. I have a terrible choice to make. I can continue to beg her to leave.
In Progress Response: I hope she will hear me out, this time.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Why is my mother here? What did she say? I hope she does not mean to lecture me AGAIN.

Title: Medicinal Qualities
Description: Collect medicinal herbs from Lough Du Lac swamp to help Sai Khanam recover from her wounds.
Objective Proposal Response: Not unscathed, I'm afraid. They came while we were resting and upended everything. It seemed as though they were searching for something.
In Progress Response: I am in no immediate danger, but I am in considerable pain. Any help you can offer is appreciated.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You found them! What fine specimens. The soil here must be very fertile.

Title: Thieves in the Night
Description: Find and retrieve Sai Khanam's stolen belongings.
Objective Proposal Response: It seems that way, doesn't it? I cannot fathom what I could have in my possession that would interest a dryad.
In Progress Response: It was very dark when they came, but I believe they ran to the west of here, up the slope behind me. Thank you again for your aid.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah! You found them! And mostly intact, too. Did the wolf come with you?

Title: Here, Boy!
Description: Help Sai Khanam track down her wolf companion.
Objective Proposal Response: After you left, he turned to me and simply plucked my bow out of my hands with his teeth!
In Progress Response: We have not traveled together long, but already I cannot imagine going on without him. I hope this is not the end of our companionship.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hello, human. I am afraid I cannot return my companion's bow to you.

Title: Scout's Big Secret
Description: Return to Sai Khanam and give her the totem Scout gave you.
Player Prompt: "I did not come for the bow."
Objective Proposal Response: You are not? Ah… Sai must be worried about me. What a strange thing, to be bound to one of your kind. Our aims are so often opposed.
In Progress Response: Please do not share the fact that I can speak with her. I will tell her, in my own time and my own way.
Destination Completion Available Respons: He came back! And-- what is this carving? Did you make this? I will cherish this, as I cherish him. I suppose I should finally choose a name for him, eh?

Title: The Work You Undid
Description: Replant the medicinal herbs you stole to their proper place within Lough Du Lac.
Objective Proposal Response: I suppose it would look like a swamp to one such as yourself. Damp, smells of mold, and rampant with life. Offensive to human noses, no doubt.
In Progress Response: We have little to say to one another until you have completed the task at hand.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I will say this about your kind; You are remarkably efficient.

Title: Waiting on the Wind
Description: Now that the wind is right, climb to the top of the bridge Avernal Verdure and burst the plant bulbs to release their pollen.
Objective Proposal Response: I keep an aerial garden above the canopy, just east of here. You can find it atop a crumbling bridge.
In Progress Response: You can use your feet to burst them, if it pleases you.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I can see from the pollen on your boots that the deed is done. Soon all of Edengrove will become my garden. Here is your payment, human.

Title: Even Greater Heights
Description: Help Hedera expand her garden by climbing the ruins and planting a flower seed at its highest point.
Objective Proposal Response: To the point. Efficient, as I said. There are ruins atop the rise to the north. It is one of the highest points in Edengrove.
In Progress Response: Try not to fall. Your bones are fragile, I have heard.
Destination Completion Available Respons: In time, the bloom will mature and the wind will carry its scent far and wide. It is a species I have cultivated from my own body. A point of pride for my kind.

Title: Hold Your Breath
Description: Destroy the strange flowers clinging to the rocks, ideally without breathing in their scent.
Objective Proposal Response: Let me… gather my thoughts. Just hold on. I had it. It was right there.
In Progress Response: Do. Not. Smell. The. Flowers.
Destination Completion Available Respons: How strange. They are gone, but the scent remains. Do you smell it? Are you afflicted too?!

Title: A Dark Compulsion
Description: Clear the path to the north and west to allow Ranger Yasin to pass unharmed to… wherever it is he is going.
Objective Proposal Response: I know how it sounds. I hear myself. My feet will move me down this path either way. I can FEEL her, waiting. How do I know this? Sahal! Wake yourself!
In Progress Response: It is taking every ounce of will I have to stay here. Please, clear the way.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Where is she? I am here! I saw it in my mind! Ranger, shake yourself out of it.

Title: Crying Out for Love
Description: Ascend the rise and light a bonfire to help signal Ranger Yasin's presence to his "love."
Objective Proposal Response: I am speaking to you with all the sincerity in my heart. If I do not find her, I will die. I know it, like I know my own name. My heart will shatter in my chest.
In Progress Response: She will see it, and she will come. She will see it, and she will come! She must…
Destination Completion Available Respons: Move aside! Surely she must--

Title: Out of His Misery
Description: Speak to the dryad Hedera to find a way to rid Ranger Yasin of his affliction.
Objective Proposal Response: My feet are bound to this spot as a tree is rooted to the earth. I can do nothing to change my fate… but you can.
In Progress Response: I feel wretched. Like my heart is being rent from my chest. Please, hurry.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah. You lived. Thank you for dealing with that nuisance. I believe I owe you coin, as per your custom.

Title: The Pioneer's Lament
Description: Help a doomed farmer move on with his life.
Objective Proposal Response: Forgive me, I’ve made a horrible, horrible mistake. I tried to start a farm in Edengrove. I moved my family here. We were to harvest paradise. Fool!
In Progress Response: Go to my farm, fight off the Angry Earth who have claimed it, and retrieve my farming equipment. And perhaps some token of my family. I am a broken, lonely man.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You found my equipment, thank god. But what’s this? A letter from my son? He says he’s raising a farm in Ebonscale Reach, the brave, resourceful lad.

Title: Art is Suffering
Description: Deface an avant-garde sculptress's embarrassing early work.
Objective Proposal Response: Ahem. Like all great artists, I was in a state of deep meditation. Creativity means surrender, not control. It took me centuries to learn that.
In Progress Response: Dispose of some poorly aged sculptures from my formative years.
Destination Completion Available Respons: All gone? Thank the Muses! Someday I shall memorialize your deeds in marble.

Title: Heart Beats Hate
Description: Harvest the heart of Aeternum's angriest Dryad Brute, for science.
Objective Proposal Response: Ay, look at yon Dryad Brute. Just stares at that tower all day, seething. Fascinating. ‘Balor the Belligerent,’ I call him.
In Progress Response: There’s a Dryad Brute called Balor the Belligerent. I need his heart. His beautiful, hate-filled heart. Kill him and bring it to me, if you would be so kind.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have the heart, do you? Very resourceful. Look at that, pumping rage and venom. Once I distill it I’ll be capable of the same.

Title: Wyldwood Water
Description: Find the Wyldwood Water recipe for Antara.
Objective Proposal Response: Hah. I only want to continue my mother's legacy. I want to find the potion she said would help us see the world as it really is.
In Progress Response: Did you find the recipe? It should be in one of the chests on this bridge.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Wonderful! I can’t believe it. You found the recipe for Wyldwood Water! I wish my mother was here to see this.

Title: Everywhere Friends
Description: Understand the message Antara's mother wanted to convey through the Wyldwood Water.
Objective Proposal Response: Hah, clever! Yes, we can't really die on this island. And you seem to have enough spirit to keep from turning Lost.
In Progress Response: How are you feeling? Do you notice anything different about the nature around you?
Destination Completion Available Respons: I'm glad you're here with me. I guess the universe works in strange ways and I'm lucky you came to the bridge when you did.

Title: Incomparable Blue
Description: Return the misplaced easel to Pietr Wolcott.
Objective Proposal Response: (The painting has been signed by a P. Wolcott. Upon closer inspection, there's a note asking for it to be returned if found.)
In Progress Response: (The painting has been signed by a P. Wolcott. Upon closer inspection, there's a note asking for it to be returned if found.)
Destination Completion Available Respons: What a gorgeous blue! It's so close to the shade I imagined.

Title: Lupine Observations
Description: Defeat Fangsnap in Fangsnap's Den for Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Animals talking, walking on two legs, and at least one of them is even taking on human form.
In Progress Response: If my suspicions are correct and animals really are taking on human form, things are gonna change.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You did it then? You hunted down the monstrous beast, Fangsnap?

Title: Pirates Will Pirate
Description: Defeat Neptunite Pirates and collect Pirate Booty from chests for Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Rilette Wilson's claiming there's a werewolf stalking the shore, and others say the Lost have gone to war.
In Progress Response: I mean, how long have the Lost pirates of Aeternum been raiding the supplies of the living?It's normal Lost pirate behavior, nothing more.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Haha! You gave those damn buccaneers a little payback, didn't you? Let's see the spoils!

Title: War of the Lost
Description: Defeat Seele's Withered at the Decayed Campsite for Magistrate Gurkin in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Indeed. The Lost Buccaneers have been fighting the Withered and vice versa.
In Progress Response: I tell you - I've fought them myself - I've seen the look in their eyes and the way it's changed.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You've seen for yourself now, haven't you? They fight with increased ferocity, with more precision, with purpose.

Title: The Greater Threat
Description: Kill Eastshore Forces at the Eastshore Pier and Gather Fishing Supplies for Magistrate Gurkin in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes! You get it, right? It sounds harmless in a way, but it's further evidence that they are more and more sentient.
In Progress Response: There was a time I used to fish from the Eastshore Pier myself.That was back before it fell to the Lost in the first place.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hah! No more fishing for the Lost! That should stop them from getting ideas.

Title: Disarmament
Description: Confiscate grenades from chests and destroy Ching Shih the Shark for Artificer Taethen in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Those blasted Lost Buccaneers are arming themselves, even developing new weapons.
In Progress Response: Watch yourself out there. Rumor says the pirates' grenades are enhanced with Azoth. Never thought I'd see the day.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Took down Ching Shih the shark, did you? And you got the grenades? Well done, {playerName}.

Title: Slaying the Shadowslayer
Description: Kill Erika the Shadowslayer in Solitude Cemetery for Artificer Taethen in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Exactly. With the Pirates pushed back, the Withered are now on the offensive.
In Progress Response: Destroy the Shadowslayer, {playerName}, whatever it takes.Then go and try to convince the Constable to finally acknowledge our plight.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So you went out and dealt with the Shadowslayer? It's about time someone did that.

Title: Where The Boars Roam
Description: Defeat Boars and Tuskgore at Boarsholm for Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: I am quite certain that the boar in question is responsible for slaying a traveler to the north.
In Progress Response: If we let this strange new mutation from the Angry Earth spread, our days our numbered.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The deed's done then? Tuskgore is no more? That is a big relief.

Title: Scouting Report
Description: Destroy Channelview Pirates in Channelview Post and Oceanview Pirates in Oceanview Post and look for anything suspicious. Then report back to Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: That's the fort up on the hill. Once upon a time, that's where the region was governed from.
In Progress Response: The more I think about this, the more I start to worry. Maybe I should've listened to Gurkin from the start.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Thank the stars you're back! What did you find? Runestones... what the heck?

Title: Damnation's Fall
Description: Defeat Admiral Reis in the center ship of Fort Damnation. Then report back to Constable Muller in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: Launch a frontal attack on Fort Damnation? Are you out of your mind?
In Progress Response: I'll give you this much - you've already proven to have the strength to back up your bravado - but if you're going to take on Admiral Reis, you'd best be prepared.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well, I thought I'd see the sun rise in the west before I saw anyone take down Admiral Reis.

Title: Paying Respects
Description: Travel to Mourningdale and convey Barkeep Andris's respects to Barkeep Brewell.
Objective Proposal Response: The Watcher there, Guerra - he fell to the Lost. Quite a hero, I understand.
In Progress Response: The news from Mourningdale is tragic, indeed.It almost make me feel guilty that things are going so well here.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Come and sit down and have a drink on the house, traveler.

Title: Archdeacon Azamela (Expedition)
Description: Collect the head of Archdeacon Azamela in The Depths for Magistrate Gurkin.
Objective Proposal Response: You’re damn right, there is! The Corrupted! The Shattered Mountain?
In Progress Response: Who knows what darkness this Archdeacon Azamela is cooking up in the Depths.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Is that it? You destroyed the Archdeacon, didn't you? There's another blow for righteousness and the good of humanity!

Title: Hoppy Trails
Description: Visit Rabbit Island and if you can find any signs of a curse then deal with them and then return to Survivalist Wilson in the Restless Shores Settlement.
Objective Proposal Response: This request is a bit more... unconventional. There is a small island nearby I would like you to investigate.
In Progress Response: A man used to live on that island all by his lonesome, kept to himself and his rabbits well enough.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So the Harekeeper passed on? I'm glad you put him to rest. His furry friends will flourish with or without him, I suspect.

Title: The First Thing I Remember
Description: Discover Santiago Salazar's past by confronting members of his former crew and tracking down a ship manifest and their journal entries.
Objective Proposal Response: I have flashes of a ship voyage, but that doesn’t say much. Who here hasn't arrived by boat? But there's more...
In Progress Response: I appreciate your help. I'd forget my own head if it wasn’t attached. What was I was looking for? My name on a manifest, right?
Destination Completion Available Respons: You're back! I feared you’d end up a soulless Withered, wandering the beaches like old Captain Cross.

Title: Footsteps on the Beach
Description: Retrace Santiago Salazars steps to find what he placed in a chest and recover Rosario's Manifest from one of his previous crewmembers.
Objective Proposal Response: You’re too kind. But I’m certain the answer lies on these shores. At the bar in the settlement, I heard from Niki Andris that I sailed on the Rosario.
In Progress Response: When I think of all my precious keepsakes scattered on these shores, I wonder what more I’m missing?
Destination Completion Available Respons: You’ve returned! And look at that! You found my missing jewelry! That ring! That brooch! And how could I forget that solid gold locket!

Title: The True Terror of the Seas
Description: Confront Santiago Salazar's previous captain Scurvyhook, and extract revenge to put Santiago's mind at ease.
Objective Proposal Response: He now goes by Scurvyhook. Never was there a captain more cruel!
In Progress Response: I finally understand why I tried so hard to forget my past.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Is the deed done? Have you destroyed those bilge rats and their vile captain? Has Scurvyhook been sent to the abyss?

Title: A Pirate's Life
Description: Follow a trail of Doubloons to reclaim the treasure Santiago's old crew had stashed away years ago.
Objective Proposal Response: Oh, right. We were merchants. But we took what we were owed! The crew hid Scurvyhook’s prized golden stash as payment for our suffering.
In Progress Response: Yeah… There's more to life than mourning what was lost.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You look like you need a drink. Hoodwinked by Salazar, were you? You weren't the first, and won't be the last.

Title: Broken Communication
Description: Recover Myrtilus's Bow from the Angry Earth at Pisces.
Objective Proposal Response: Aside from one who is blind to the land talking with us? The seasons are amiss in Verdant Ascent.
In Progress Response: Our bow was left where the fish swim across the sky.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Impressive! We did not expect much. All you did at first was stare.

Title: Spined Ammunition
Description: Recover Myrtilus's Quiver and Thornpoint Arrows from the Angry Earth at Fornax.
Objective Proposal Response: If we returned, it would be like an early winter frost. There would be long discourses about the merits of staying secure at Eridanus.
In Progress Response: The Thornpoint arrows were made specifically for use with this bow. Like a layer of strong bark, they protect against all sorts of dangers on the road.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Once again you do not disappoint. These arrows shall do nicely.

Title: Trail Rations
Description: Recover Nutrient Stalks from containers at Eridanus for Myrtilus.
Objective Proposal Response: When times are good, a pleasant rain and warm sunlight is enough.
In Progress Response: It is best to rely on sustenance untouched by foulness. Please bring us the nourishment we need to begin our journey.
Destination Completion Available Respons: We can smell the freshness of the nutrient stalks from here. We relish the chance to have a taste while on the road.

Title: Unnatural Habitation
Description: Search Clawpoint Ruins for any clues as to why there are lynx in the area.
Player Prompt: "It's not like we can just leave."
Objective Proposal Response: True. We're trapped on this island. Just like those poor lynx.
In Progress Response: The clues are out there, I know it. I can feel the answer is at Clawpoint Ruins. Search the ruins and let me know what you discover.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Let me guess – you found cages, didn’t you?

Title: A Hair's Breadth from Danger
Description: Search the poacher's camp for any letters about their activities.
Objective Proposal Response: When I visited the poachers camp, I was able to get answers to some of my questions, but it was clear there was more to their plans.
In Progress Response: I need more information about what those poachers were doing. The lynx were just the smallest part of their plan.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Something has changed. Don’t tell me they've returned! Blast it, I should have burned that place to the ground when I had the chance!

Title: Rule of Tooth and Claw
Description: Right the wrongs done to the local wolf pack.
Objective Proposal Response: Our choices are limited. The damage has been done. And we don't have anything that can counter what they did.
In Progress Response: You go on ahead, I'll be right behind you. The wolf cave isn't that far away, you can't miss it.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So, you met the mad Caryn Berzs. She’s an odd one, I’ll give you that. She’s wanted for freeing the local dogs.

Title: Fisherman's Allure
Description: Search for treasure at Poseidon's Plunder for Wafa Keles.
Objective Proposal Response: What do I have to offer? I’m good at spearfishing. And few can climb sea-slick rocks as well as I can.
In Progress Response: I don't have much, but what I do have I'm willing to share with Xue Tian.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Is that what you found? Impressive! Xue will be thrilled to see this!

Title: Treasured Company
Description: Bring a letter from Wafa Keles to Xue Tian
Player Prompt: "You could ask him to appraise it."
Objective Proposal Response: Yes! I could say I found this goblet, and ask him to take a look. I like it! But I’m so nervous! Just the thought of talking to him makes me weak-kneed.
In Progress Response: I know I’ll have to talk to Xue on my own someday… but could you ask him to stop by for me?
Destination Completion Available Respons: A message from Wafa Keles asking me to appraise something called Poseidon’s Goblet? Sounds intriguing…

Title: Not Another Fish in the Sea
Description: Recover Xue's Sea Glass Charms from the Treetop pirates that stole them.
Objective Proposal Response: I needed some space. And had to get away from my overbearing family.
In Progress Response: Those Treetop pirates stole my Sea Glass Charms. They would be a perfect gift for Wafa. Please get them back.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Those are perfect! Can you imagine them hanging from their hair, catching the sunlight as they dance through the waves?

Title: Meat For Nekumanesh (Expedition)
Description: Collect Hunks of Meat for Nekumanesh the alligator from Corrupted Leaders in The Depths Expedition.
Objective Proposal Response: The alligator snaps at you, clearly offended by the insinuation that he isn't big enough.
In Progress Response: Nekumanesh looks at you suspiciously. He had been expecting you to return with food.
Destination Completion Available Respons: With a snap of his jaws, Nekumanesh hungrily devours the meat. As he looks up at you for more, you wonder: Did he just get a little bigger...?

Title: Wispy Spritz Bombs
Description: The Bloom Herald offers to share the secret to true freedom if a rare blossom, the Wispy Bloom, can be safely collected.
Objective Proposal Response: It can be yours. Let Hashiki Kimani, the chosen Bloom Herald, guide you.
In Progress Response: Craft the Wispy Spritz bombs. Only with this item will you be able to collect the Wispyblooms and discover a secret world.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You’ve crafted the spritz, well done! Now you are ready to take the next step toward enlightenment.

Title: Springtide Bloom
Description: Armed with the Wispy Spritz bomb, the Bloom Herald has requested that the precious petals of the Wispyblooms be collected and brought to her in order to further the quest for harmony.
Player Prompt: “How exactly do I use the Spritz?”
Objective Proposal Response: You must plant the traps on the ground then cleverly lure the wasp swarms to them before they explode.
In Progress Response: Bring me the petals of the Wispybloom, Truth Seeker. I can help you achieve peace and harmony.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You bring me the keys to bliss! You are an exceptional Truth Seeker and worthy of being a Child of Bloom.
