Brimstone Under Siege
Description: A troubled woman at the Refugee Caravan has warned of an impending attack by the Corrupted Legion, and has asked for your help to defend the civilians.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" bin="1" bout="2" />When I want something. We’re in desperate need of capable warriors!
In Progress Response: <g id="g_litearmor_pleadhandsopen" priority="high" />These people are refugees, not soldiers. They can’t repel an assault by the Corrupted Legion.<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" /> Please stop those vicious murderers!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ha! You’ve done it! My instincts are never wrong!<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> Well, not when it’s important.

Title: The Great Architect
Description: Ghazi Laghmani has asked for any possible assistance in finding her teacher, the Great Sage Imhotep, last seen near The Acropolis.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />The Great Sage of Brimstone! Oldest<g id="g_female_leanpointconvince" /> living soul on Aeternum, friend to the Ancients, architect of the Great Pyramid at Akhet!
In Progress Response: <g id="g_litearmor_secretiveshort" />Have you found any sign of the Great Sage Imhotep?<g id="g_litearmor_hopeless" /> We desperately need his wisdom.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />You’ve returned! To be honest, I wasn't sure if you would.<g id="g_litearmor_takeitem5s" priority="high" /> What’s this? A journal page?

Title: Preemptive Strike
Description: Ghazi has received word that the Corrupted Legion is preparing an even larger assault on the Caravan. While she heads north to search for Imhotep, she has asked you to attack the Legion directly at their garrison of Crassus's Rise.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Noticed that, did you? They’re the original Romans who<g id="g_litearmor_converseleft" /> founded New Corsica centuries ago.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />If you thin the ranks at the Legion garrison, that might take the fight out of those vicious brutes.<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> And believe me, they have it coming.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I was<g id="g_litearmor_youknow" bin="1" bout="1.5"/> hoping to see your striking visage again! And your aura of<g id="g_litearmor_agree1" /> confidence has grown. That can only mean victory, yes? Well done!

Title: Stirring in the Sands
Description: Imhotep continues to investigate a new threat, heading west toward Carthago. Once found, Ghazi anxiously awaits news of his return at Cavalier's Rest.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />I’m afraid it’s… complicated. You see, when someone lives as long as Imhotep, their mind can become<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> full and sometimes spill, like a vessel holding too much water.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_female_clasphandsconvince" />Have you searched Carthago for any signs of Imhotep and Aban? We must find them!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />You’ve returned! By Isis, you're tougher than old crocodile leather.<g id="g_male_headshakeno" /> But your look is so grim. I’m afraid to ask…

Title: A Blossoming Threat
Description: With the ambush by the Angry Earth, Ghazi is certain they are responsible for Imhotep's disappearance. She knows the Angry Earth have been seen around Jupiter's Grove, and asks again for your continued help in finding Imhotep.\n\nGhazi's scouts have reported that you will need a ranged weapon to complete this task.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_litearmor_headtilthmm" />Angry Earth? They must have attacked Imhotep. I’ve never heard of them wandering that far.
In Progress Response: (Blank Space)
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />You made it! You're becoming as reliable as the dawn!

Title: Past Prologue
Description: While Imhotep recuperates from his recent tribulations, Ghazi has suggested you read Imhotep's 'Legacy of the Ancients' and learn of the impact the Ancients had on Brimstone Sands.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" />The Pontifex Charmion, a spiritual leader here for many years.<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> She was once very wise, but she’s lost her way.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />Have you looked at Imhotep’s scroll? I think you’ll find it illuminating.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_why" />I am NOT BEING LOUD! I'm simply worried about you-<g id="g_litearmor_whatwantfromme" /> think about Aban!

Title: Watering the Seed
Description: Recovered from his kidnapping, the Great Sage Imhotep has told you of the strange seed carried north by the Angry Earth, likely to the Oasis Spontanea. He and Ghazi will await you at the Great Shrine of Thoth.
Player Prompt: "You need me to find the Seed."
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_youknows" />You see what I said about our friend here?
In Progress Response: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />I'll never forget your help in rescuing Imhotep. I’m in your debt.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ah, there you are! No doubt you’ve witnessed all manner of fascinating events and faced innumerable perils.

Title: Unraveling the Mystery
Description: Unable to breach the magic of the Ancient focus, Imhotep knows of a powerful spell which may provide answers. Relics from Aqua Anuket, Arit-en-Geb, and Anhur's Pride should empower his magic enough to succeed.
Objective Proposal Response: Oh, I knew them.<g id="g_male_nod2" bin="1" bout="1.5" /> Well enough to worry about a device like this.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Have you collected the components I need to unlock the Ancient device?
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_shocked" />No! It cannot be- we have unleashed the demon!

Title: Accursed Apophis
Description: Apophis's remarks have Imhotep worried about a grander machination involving Ancient technology. He suggests investigating an undisturbed Ancient vault in Hermopolis, where Apophis may have found materials for his plans, while he and Ghazi return to New Corsica.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_male_converseright"  bin="2" bout="2"/>The Ancients awakened the Angry Earth to battle Corruption.<g id="g_female_fingerwagno"  bin="2" bout="2"/> But their deadly weapon perceived us as a threat as well.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />Go to Hermopolis and find a way to access the Ancient vault. We must discover Apophis’s plan before it’s too late.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />My mighty Sword returns! You shine with the light of Ra. What<g id="g_male_headtilthmm" /> mysteries have you uncovered in the vault?<g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" /> Speak to your pharaoh!

Title: The Demon's Cauldron
Description: Imhotep's translation speaks of a method to merge two beings together, a practice thought long lost. The sulfurous jar indicates a visit to the Pools of Orcus to the west, and he asks your help in searching for clues to Apophis's plans.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_male_shakehead" />I did not think it possible. But perhaps I was mistaken.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />Have you been to the Pools of Orcus? We must know what manner of abomination Apophis is creating.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />Is there no task that you cannot accomplish? Ptah has crafted me a very fine weapon indeed.

Title: Power of the Ancients
Description: Imhotep is intimately familiar with the fragment of the Ancient power source, having designed the Pyramid of Akhet to house it. He suggests searching near Diospolis for an entry point to the pyramid's interior, the origin of the fragment.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_gestureleftm" />When active, it powered the Ancients’ great machines throughout the island.<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" /> Hm. Apophis did boast he had been granted power.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_female_lifthandsxs" />Find your way into Akhet via the Diospolis entrance. We must know what Apophis intends to do with the Ennead’s power.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_female_explains" />Even here, I sensed the surge of power from Akhet!<g id="g_female_shakeheadno" /> The earth hums with the energized blood flowing through her veins.

Title: Scourge of Aeon Madness
Description: Adiana's revelation at the pyramid has caused Imhotep's Aeon Madness to assert itself, and Ghazi has asked for help in gathering local herbs needed to treat the Great Sage. She will attempt to calm Imhotep while you prepare the recipe.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />I devised a more potent formula but I’ve run out of the materials to create it.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_male_why" />Imhotep's mind teeters on the edge! We need the improved elixir to heal him!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_litearmor_concerns" />Oh great Osiris! Imhotep is gone!

Title: The Eye of Horus
Description: Ghazi's concern at Imhotep's flight is evident, and she begs your assistance in chasing him down. He ran toward the Gates of Sutekh, ranting about the Eye of Horus and the return of the gods.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_litearmor_lifthandsxs" />He must be headed to the Gates of Sutekh. They lie to the west.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_litearmor_pleadhandsopen" /> Go to the Gates of Sutekh. Imhotep is there searching for the Eye of Horus. You must find it before he does!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Retrieve the Eye of Horus! Use your staff! Track its potent quintessence!

Title: Challenging the Pharaoh
Description: The Eye of Horus has been taken, but droplets of quintessence form a path to follow. Imhotep, or perhaps something worse, must be at the end of the trail.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_compliment" />You have the code! Excellent! Ghazi’s faith in you is not misplaced.<g id="g_female_nodyes" /> Her instincts are never wrong.

Title: A God Awakens
Description: With the Eye of Horus in hand, Imhotep has given you the location of the Necropolis of Sutekh, the resting place of an Ancient. Adiana and Apophis must not be allowed to rouse Sutekh from his slumber!
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_pointthreaten" />That must not happen! You must prevent Sutekh’s return at all costs!
In Progress Response: <g id="g_male_pointblame" />You must stop Apophis from awakening Sutekh! An Ancient of his power would wreak havoc on this land!
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_compliment" />Ah. The Sword of Brimstone returns! You have defeated a mighty demon and brought order to this land.

Title: The Wild Huntress
Description: With the immediate threat stymied and Imhotep stabilized, he has recalled long forgotten memories about a shrine to Artemis somewhere in the northern reaches of Everfall. Visiting it may provide a clue to Adiana's - Artemis's - next move.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_nodding" />I fear that is what the signs do clearly portend. Though Artemis was known to take human form, her hatred for our species was legendary.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_female_gesturerights" />Have you traveled to the Daughterwell? You may learn more of Artemis’s true intentions.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_male_spreadarms001" />You’ve returned! I would guess a confrontation with Artemis did not occur then?

Title: The Missing Praetorians
Description: Captain Andrea Clermont has asked you to find her fellow Praetorians. If they've become Lost, help them find peace and bring back proof of their defeat.
Objective Proposal Response: These Praetorians were to guard the roads so citizens could evacuate the city. We'd received troubling reports of bandits so I was dispatched to check on their status.
In Progress Response: Those missing Praetorians were my responsibility. I'm ultimately to blame for their fates.
Destination Completion Available Respons: So my suspicions were correct? I prayed it would be otherwise. Those Praetorians were brave soldiers… and good friends.

Title: Personal Demons
Description: Discover if Praetorian Malatesta still lives. If he has become Lost, defeat him and retrieve his insignia
Objective Proposal Response: He had a... regrettable past. I can't speak further without betraying his confidence. What’s important now is that we discover his fate.
In Progress Response: Please, I must know the fate of Praetorian Malatesta. It's important to me.
Destination Completion Available Respons: A letter from Emiliano? He was... robbing the evacuating citizens?

Title: Duties Maintained
Description: Take Captain Clermont’s reports back to Prefect Severan in New Corsica.
Objective Proposal Response: The roads must be guarded, no matter the circumstances or the cost. That was Praetorian Malatesta’s mission. And now it’s mine.
In Progress Response: I pray the Prefect is able to find recruits for the Praetorian Guard. We are in desperate need.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Praise Jupiter! Captain Clermont still lives! Her loss would’ve been a great blow to New Corsica.

Title: Roar of the Manticore
Description: Inside the Acropolis, investigate the threats that plague the trade route.
Objective Proposal Response: This caravan was due to deliver vital supplies from New Corsica to the outpost near The Acropolis.
In Progress Response: Have you had a change of heart? I can't blame you.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Jupiter's balls! Look at the size of that stinger! Oh, see! I told you he was telling the truth! Tell me, what did the beast look like?

Title: Audience with the Pontifex
Description: Prelate Razin has blocked you from speaking with Pontifex Charmion until you have gained an understanding of the True Gods, and the threat posed the Legion. Read the ‘Legacy of Rome’, then speak with the Prelate again.
Objective Proposal Response: It will reveal the truth of what afflicts this land. It must be made known to all who enter here.
In Progress Response: You must meditate on the Sacred Scroll of Awakening if you wish to speak to Pontifex Charmion.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The Light of Truth has blessed you! Now, speak to the Pontifex. You will benefit from her wisdom.

Title: Power of the Gods
Description: Pontifex Charmion has requested that you seek out Pontiff Nuru in the Cradle of Nu and offer her aid.
Objective Proposal Response: General Crassus, curse his name! Once trusted with our defense and considered a hero, he and his legionaries now ravage the land as bloodthirsty Corrupted!
In Progress Response: Have you aided Nuru? The gods whisper to me of your great destiny here.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The Pontifex sent you? Oh, praise the gods! I cannot possibly accomplish this task on my own.

Title: The Sleeping Vessels
Description: Search the wreckage for materials to craft Pontiff Nuru’s relic.
Objective Proposal Response: Some in this land call the gods the Ancients. The people of New Corsica call them the Blessed Nine.
In Progress Response: Have you found the materials for the holy relic? Without them, I cannot awaken these sacred vessels.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Yes, this is precisely what I need. Now, let me see… the design must be strictly followed…

Title: Gems of the Immortals
Description: Pontiff Nuru has asked you to defeat Anubian Automata and Constructs, and collect the gems they possess.
Objective Proposal Response: It’s not finished. It requires gems to channel the gods' divine power. The idols possess such gems as eyes.
In Progress Response: Those gems should be the final pieces I require. New Corsica depends upon our success!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have the gems! Wonderful! Now I must arrange them in a pattern pleasing to the gods. Yes, that seems right…

Title: Awakening Anubis
Description: Pontiff Nuru has asked you to use the holy relic at the sarcophagus to awaken the Hand of Anubis.
Objective Proposal Response: Place it carefully on the sarcophagus. It will awaken the vessel slumbering within and place it under your control.
In Progress Response: I am praying for the gods to protect you when you use the relic.
Destination Completion Available Respons: It awoke and went berserk? Oh gods, no! I followed the Pontifex’s instruction to the letter! My prayer must have been insufficient.

Title: Insufficient Faith
Description: Report Pontiff Nuru’s failure to awaken the Anubian vessels to Pontifex Charmion.
Objective Proposal Response: No, there is no other explanation. The gods are blameless so the fault must lie with me. The Pontifex will not be pleased…
In Progress Response: I am ready to receive the Pontifex’s judgement.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Nuru failed?! That is a great disappointment and it will cost New Corsica dearly.

Title: Cursed Across Centuries
Description: Speak with Ariel Gideon about the plan to fight the 19th Legion, then find Tribune Kraus on the Scorched Battlefield.
Player Prompt: “Is that why the city is barren?”
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, most of our citizens have fled. A brave few volunteered to fight against Crassus.
In Progress Response: If you truly wish to help New Corsica, seek Tribune Kraus on the Scorched Battlefield.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Reinforcements? Thank the stars! I had almost given up hope.

Title: Assault Against the Legion
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to defeat 19th Legion troops in their war camps.
Objective Proposal Response: They seem to be preparing a strike against New Corsica, but I can’t be sure. There’s too many of them and I can’t get a closer look.
In Progress Response: We must thin out the 19th Legion’s numbers.
Destination Completion Available Respons: That was most impressive! While you were engaging those legionaries, I managed to get a closer look.

Title: The Hydra's Breath
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to steal Hydra’s Breath from the 19th Legion to help destroy the enemy's siege weapons.
Objective Proposal Response: They’re Crassus’s army, formed by Mark Antony in Egypt during Cleopatra’s rebellion.
In Progress Response: Without casks of Hydra’s Breath, we have no chance of destroying those siege engines.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Excellent work! With the power of Hydra’s Breath in our possession, we now have a fighting chance.

Title: A Blaze of Glory
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to destroy the 19th Legion's artillery and defeat Primus Vespasian.
Player Prompt: “I found this vial and a scroll.”
Objective Proposal Response: Hmm, I’ve never seen anything like the substance in this vial. It’s very strange. The scroll is written in Greek. It’s a formula for something.
In Progress Response: If Ignatius’s words are true, our time is short. You must destroy the artillery.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, what a victory! New Corsica shall be spared destruction by fire. We are in your debt.

Title: The Last True Centurion
Description: Tribune Kraus has asked you to find and restore the New Corsican hero Evandrus.
Objective Proposal Response: He is Crassus’s son! Turned to stone all those centuries ago. His petrified body rests at the Legion’s old fort.
In Progress Response: Restore Evandrus! He is the ally we need!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Uhhh… my vision swims with shadows… am I still dreaming…? What has happened?

Title: A Legend Restored
Description: Inform the newly awakened Evandrus of the current invasion then report back to Tribune Kraus.
Player Prompt: “You were stone for a long time.”
Objective Proposal Response: How? Were we attacked? I recall my father was marching to Akhet. He left me and a small garrison to guard the fort.
In Progress Response: I shall return to New Corsica as soon as my head has cleared. There is so much to consider…
Destination Completion Available Respons: Evandrus has been restored? Praise be! Our fortunes are certain to change! Where is he? What does he intend to do?

Title: A Hero No More
Description: Inform Evandrus that Charmion commands him to return to New Corsica.
Objective Proposal Response: Deceiver! I believed you to be sent by the gods! Now I see you for who you truly are!
In Progress Response: Atone for your sins! Find Evandrus and deal with him!
Destination Completion Available Respons: It is good to see a familiar face! What news do you bring?

Title: Ultimate Intentions
Description: Evandrus has asked that you infiltrate the Corrupted Legion camp and steal their communications.
Objective Proposal Response: The power of that insidious sickness is unknown to me. Charmion insists it was my father's blasphemous pact that freed the Legion.
In Progress Response: The sooner we can get those deployment reports, the sooner we can formulate our plan.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have the reports! Excellent! Hmm, it seems someone has made an impression on them. I take it that was you?

Title: Strength and Weakness
Description: Destroy the 19th Legion's supplies and slay Centurion Magnus.
Objective Proposal Response: I never did like that brute. I’d be happy to have him sent to the Underworld.
In Progress Response: Give my regards to that brute Magnus, would you?
Destination Completion Available Respons: By the helm of Mars! I can hear the chaos you've unleashed on the camp from here!

Title: One Tribune at a Time
Description: In order to weaken Drusilla, you must take out her tribunes, one by one.
Objective Proposal Response: Mark Antony made her a tribune because he needed commanders against Octavian in Egypt. Drusilla’s ruthless tactics seemingly impressed him.
In Progress Response: Eliminating five highly trained tribunes would be too great a task for most, but I feel you are different.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Five Tribunes of the 19th Legion felled in battle! Even the mighty Achilles would be impressed!

Title: Head of the Snake
Description: Destroy the Legion’s command tents and defeat Prefect Drusilla.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, I cannot deny that, though I wish it were not so.
In Progress Response: Drusilla's shade is long overdue in the Underworld. Send her on her way.
Destination Completion Available Respons: By Jupiter, you’ve done it! Drusilla’s defeat has already begun to scatter the Legion’s forces. In salute of you, noble hero!

Title: Sic Transit Gloria Mundi
Description: Return to Charmion with news of your success against Drusilla's forces.
Objective Proposal Response: I am grateful, my friend. I must think only of my duty to New Corsica. Her safety is all that matters now.
In Progress Response: Inform Charmion that Drusilla and her centurions have been defeated.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You allowed Evandrus to live? Your victory against Drusilla proves nothing!

Title: Secrets in the Sands
Description: Speak to Pontiff Nuru at the Ancients' Rise and help her uncover the secrets of the Ennead.
Objective Proposal Response: Severan warned me that her mind was slipping. I will have to ask him to have her watched.
In Progress Response: What has Pontiff Nuru discovered at the Ancients' Rise? Her findings may be our salvation.
Destination Completion Available Respons: My relic-builder! It’s so good to see you again!

Title: Miracles and Madness
Description: Recover Charmion’s journal and the Great Ennead Codex to reveal the secrets of Akhet.
Objective Proposal Response: She possesses such knowledge. She was once Cleopatra’s handmaiden, a priestess of Egypt.
In Progress Response: Did you find the journal and the Codex tablets? We must learn what we can about Akhet.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You’ve found the Codex! And the Pontifex’s journal as well! Praise the gods! Whatever they may actually be…

Title: Hieratic Truth
Description: You must gather pieces of the Prime Key.
Objective Proposal Response: Oh, gods... Crassus did not release Medusa’s Curse. It was the Pontifex!
In Progress Response: Have you recovered the pieces of the Prime Key? We may not have much time left.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You recovered the pieces! Praise the Blessed Nine! Sorry, force of habit…

Title: The Key that was Broken
Description: Destroy the Lore Keeper and reforge the Prime Key.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, but we were using an Egyptian text to try and control powers on Aeternum.
In Progress Response: Did you reforge the Prime Key? I can’t wait to see what it looks like.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You’re alive! Thank the gods! And you’ve reforged the Prime Key!

Title: Circles in Time
Description: Report what you have discovered about Akhet and the reforged Prime Key to Evandrus.
Player Prompt: "How do we use the Prime Key?”
Objective Proposal Response: The Codex mentions glyphs in the Forge of Ptah that speak of the Key’s function.
In Progress Response: Tell Evandrus what we’ve done. Tell him there is hope for New Corsica!
Destination Completion Available Respons: The hero of New Corsica returns! And bearing gifts! What is that strange device?

Title: The Mighty Must Fall (Expedition)
Description: Evandrus has asked you to go to the Ennead and confront his father General Crassus.
Objective Proposal Response: I was hoping that terrible plague could be resisted by someone with a noble heart and a strong mind.
In Progress Response: Release my father from his torment, I beg you. His threat to New Corsica must be ended.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hail, hero of New Corsica! The people have named me their new Legatus.

Title: The Final Seal (Expedition)
Description: Enter the Pyramid of Akhet and seal the Ennead with the Prime Key to protect the people of Aeternum.
Objective Proposal Response: Thank you! Charmion was wrong. The Ennead is not a gate to be opened. It must be sealed.
In Progress Response: You must insert the Prime Key into the Ennead. Its power is too dangerous to leave uncontained.
Destination Completion Available Respons: That beam of celestial light is the most beautiful thing I’ve ever seen! Could this have been how the builders of Akhet spoke with their gods?

Title: Secret in the Desert
Description: With Apophis no longer a threat, Imhotep has turned his attention to matters closer to home. He has asked assistance in recovering a precious and mysterious parcel, buried long ago.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_gesturebothhands" />There is a parcel I wish recovered. You may find it buried to the south,<g id="g_female_gesturerightm" /> near a place sacred to Sobek.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_male_leanforwardinspect" />Have you acquired my parcel? It contains something of great value to<g id="g_male_converseleft" /> all of Brimstone. Please retrieve it.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_female_takeitem5s" priority="high" />Ah, our precious parcel. Thank you. I knew we would need this someday.

Title: A Queen Revealed
Description: Ghazi's true identity has been revealed - Cleopatra VII Thea Philopater, Queen of Egypt! Her return would bring hope to the people of New Corsica, but Evandrus may have other ideas. Speak with him to determine his feelings.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_gestureforward02" />Yes, our dear Ghazi is indeed Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_male_headtilthmm" />Have you spoken to Evandrus about Queen Cleopatra’s return?<g id="g_female_explains" /> His opinion is vital to swaying Ghazi.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="g_litearmor_youknow" />Have you spoken with Evandrus? What did he say?<g id="g_litearmor_shakehead" /> Do not spare my feelings. Well, maybe spare them<g id="g_litearmor_shrugbrief" /> just a little…

Title: The Coronation
Description: With Evandrus's support, Cleopatra has consented to retake her position of power. Inform all of New Corsica of her return, then attend her coronation at the Royal Pavilion.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="g_female_spreadarms" />It’s not the challenge that worries me. I’ve faced<g id="g_female_gestureleftm" /> many perils in the service of Imhotep, as you have seen.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_female_leanforwardsmall" />Have you spoken to the people? I<g id="g_litearmor_converseright" /> must know how they feel about my potential return.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well, that’s done. Now the real work begins for us.

Title: Tremors in the Sand
Description: One of Imhotep's allies, Lysandra, has sent warning of strange events in the sands. Imhotep has asked you to seek her out and assist her in determining their cause.
Objective Proposal Response: By Ra's Light, let's hope not! I was hoping you could investigate.
In Progress Response: <g id="g_female_youknow" />Have you spoken to Lysandra about those strange tremors in the desert?<g id="g_female_tiltheadremember" /> We need to know what is causing them.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You found spines? Good gods... I will study these and see what I can glean.

Title: The Ancient Glyphs
Description: William Heron seeks an intrepid adventurer to search for Ancient Glyphs. Collect the glyph at the ruins of Satet, discover its purpose, and return to Heron in New Corsica.
Objective Proposal Response: Ha ha! Around here, one could blindly throw a stone and hit something interesting.
In Progress Response: Trust me, you'll understand the… oddities of Ancient glyphs better if you find one yourself.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Well? A fascinating experience, wasn't it? Knowing the meaning of the glyph acted as a key for you.

Title: Scarab Secrets
Description: Eudoxia Dalassema needs someone willing to crack open Anubian Scarab Constructs and mine out the power sources within--preferably without alerting the authorities in New Corsica.
Objective Proposal Response: Then I have your attention? Excellent.
In Progress Response: The constructs cluster near Khnum, though I've never understood why. The ruin's naught but crumbling walls. Are they guarding something?
Destination Completion Available Respons: Oh, these devices look like toys! Can something this small give life to an entire construct?

Title: Lone Jackal
Description: Slay the jackals of Deadwater Den who attacked Senhyris, and find some medicine to treat her wounds.
Objective Proposal Response: Do I look all right to you? Between the desert and the beasts, I'm lucky I'm even breathing.
In Progress Response: Did you lose your nerve? Or maybe you thought better of chasing after jackals.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Is that medicine? You didn't have to do that. Thank you. For driving off the jackals, and saving my sorry skin.

Title: Ruffled Feathers
Description: Nesse van Baten wants revenge on "Featherbane" the lion, who has developed an unfortunate taste for domestic poultry. Go to Two-Stones Grotto, then meet back up with Nesse at the nearby Outpost.
Objective Proposal Response: Help? Hah! That would be a first in this godforsaken wasteland.
In Progress Response: I didn't name the lion "Featherbane." One of the other refugees thought it was funny.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Featherbane is gone? That's the first good news I've heard in weeks!

Title: Aggressive Negotiations
Description: Huang Xiaoling is looking for a man who may have shipwrecked on the southern coast of Brimstone Sands. Search for any survivors at The Offering, then meet up with Xiaoling at Cavalier's Rest.
Objective Proposal Response: Yes, I watched from safety. What was I to do, wade out into the waves and battle them myself?
In Progress Response: What possessed the Ambassador to keep sailing through such a terrible storm?
Destination Completion Available Respons: It's you. And since you are unscathed and uncorrupted, I assume you found Ambassador Li? Or he did not make it ashore?

Title: Broken Pedestals
Description: Froderico Renaldi is beside himself after being murdered just outside Castrum Inferos. Recover the unfortunate historian's belongings from the Castrum, and return them to him.
Objective Proposal Response: I sent a letter to their camp, announcing my intentions to survey their buildings for posterity.
In Progress Response: If Caesar, Augustus, and Antony could see how far their Roman brethren had fallen… Would they weep at this degeneracy?
Destination Completion Available Respons: My notes! Grazie mille, friend. That's my life's work… though it may need some revision.

Title: An Ancient Balancing Act
Description: Perrin Mercier discovered a tantalizing mystery in the collapsed Roman aqueduct, but can't climb it himself. Brave the treacherous ascent into the aqueduct, then return to Perrin with your findings.
Objective Proposal Response: Ah. Mostly my ego bruised. Have you read the writings of William Heron? His words inspired me to be an antiquarian.
In Progress Response: Be careful, friend. I thought the aqueduct looked easy to climb, and I paid for my hubris.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You really did it? Climbed the aqueduct and came back in one piece? The last mercenary who passed through just scoffed at me.

Title: Coming Forth by Day
Description: Acolyte Miresis seeks Egyptian funerary rites from his former mentor Psherenamun, who has become Lost. Seek out Psherenamun at Castrum Perdita, take the texts from him, and return to Saboteur's Hideaway.
Objective Proposal Response: Before we came to Aeternum, my people performed nearly two hundred incantations for the dead. But the practice faded long ago.
In Progress Response: Where did we go wrong? Was it the incantations? The images? The mystical names of the judges?
Destination Completion Available Respons: You return! And you seem sound of mind and body. But what of Psherenamun? Was he still…?

Title: The Insatiable Flame
Description: Bring delicious fish to the Insatiable Flame before he decides to make a snack out of you. You can catch fresh fish from any fishing hotspot in Brimstone Sands.
Objective Proposal Response: And I'd rather not go hungry! So what do you mean to do about it, human?
In Progress Response: Fish? No? Then begone.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Mrr, the delectable aroma of fish. This is much better than eating you.

Title: Artistic License
Description: Enez de Barros is convinced that there are dragon eggs at the Palace of Nekhbet. Search the reptile nests for eggs of any sort, and bring them back for Enez's inspection.
Objective Proposal Response: That's a shame. As a little girl, I loved stories of dragons, and I was hoping to find some for creative inspiration.
In Progress Response: My father used to read me the story of Saint George, and I always felt sorry for the dragon.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Hmm, just by looking at your face, I can see there were no dragons awaiting you. Ah, well. Perhaps they hide elsewhere on Aeternum.

Title: Path of the Devourer
Description: Lysandra is distressed by strange tremors that have recently rocked the Great Pyramid of Akhet. Survey the area around the pyramid's base, and find evidence of what is causing the tremors.
Objective Proposal Response: See the pyramid? Quiet for eons, but tremors started beneath its base a few weeks ago.
In Progress Response: If you see something bigger than you, run. If it's bigger and faster, hide.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Don't take this the wrong way, friend, but you look like you've seen terrible things. I'm not going to like what you found, am I?

Title: The Antiquarian's Dream
Description: Emboldened by your success at the aqueduct, Perrin seeks your help to unlock the function of an Ancient stone gateway. Look for clues in the ruins of Hermopolis, then return to Perrin at the Great Shrine of Thoth.
Objective Proposal Response: That could be. I've never had the chance to compare the different gateways.
In Progress Response: Oh please, let me know as soon as you've visited Hermopolis.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You… what did you do? How did you accomplish that?! I found the very same glyph, but I never produced even a flicker of magic!

Title: The Queen's Brood (Elite)
Description: The naturalist Tamouthis is concerned by the sudden and unnatural proliferation of massive scorpions in the Bubasteum. Venture into the Beds of Ta-Bitjet and slay the scorpion queen who lives there.
Objective Proposal Response: You're cautious. Good to see that fame and glory haven't gone to your head.
In Progress Response: Hmm… I don't know what's behind the brood's unnatural behavior, but for now, exterminating them is all that matters.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I can smell the scorpion ichor from here. Was it a good hunt? Did you learn why these scorpions were so ferocious?

Title: Secrets of the Heartgem
Description: <font color="#b2aea1">HEARTRUNE UNLOCK QUEST</font>\nThe Soulwardens sent Anna Rózsa to learn about an intriguing source of power in Brimstone Sands. Unlock your Heartgem's hidden potential at the Great Wall of Nebet-Het, then meet Scout Rózsa at the Palace of Nekhbet.
Objective Proposal Response: You may have heard the rumors, but a Soulwarden's Heartgem can grant additional powers through the etching of specific runes.
In Progress Response: Sorry I couldn't tell you more about the Wall. You'll know it when you see it.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You're back! What a relief. I wouldn't know what to say to the other Soulwardens if something happened to our hero.

Title: The Gods' Demand
Description: The priest Paubastis needs you to venture near the temple ruins of Henkhisesui, slay a lion, and bring back its heart. He promises good payment but refuses to explain why.
Objective Proposal Response: A reasonable answer. You know that this land has faced harsh trials lately.
In Progress Response: Surely someone like you is accustomed to slaying large wildlife?
Destination Completion Available Respons: You're back with the heart? I have some coin for you. Our business is concluded, and you can be on your way.

Title: Flower of the Sands
Description: Collect Cactus Flowers in memory of Zahur's husband and bring them to him in the Camp.
Player Prompt: "What is it you can't leave behind?"
Objective Proposal Response: The memories... of my love. Titus and I were friends for decades, but then it blossomed into something more.
In Progress Response: My sweet Titus. I will not leave with nothing to remember him by.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Ah, you found them. Just as bright and beautiful as the day my Titus came in from the sands.

Title: Sand Walkers
Description: Defeat the Sand Walkers in The Acropolis for Tahirah.
Objective Proposal Response: The sands…. they come to life and walk on two feet! Just like you and me! It is most unnatural!
In Progress Response: These Sand Walkers… they mean to replace us. I swear it. You must strike them down!
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have returned the Walkers to the sands! Heroes like you saved us once before.

Title: Honoring the 19th
Description: Confiscate Pickaxes from the Corrupted 19th, and recover their Legion Insignias for Acario Clemon.
Objective Proposal Response: It is a dark tale I do not care to dwell upon. In recent years, some of us have taken up the banner to restore the Legion's honor.
In Progress Response: We will restore honor to the crest of the 19th Legion, no matter how long it takes.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I heard the clamor. It sounded like you dealt those villains a blow that'll shut them down! Well done!

Title: On Duty, the Sun Never Sets
Description: Once Priestess of the Lamp of Osiris, Qabalah asks you to destroy the Ancient Guardians that contol the temple and retrieve the sacred Spark of Osiris from the Lamplighter. The Lamplighter ascends the ruins at day, but descends into a hidden chamber at night.
Objective Proposal Response: The Ancient Anubians, servant-constructs to the Ancients themselves. They prevent humans from trespassing.
In Progress Response: The Lamplighter appears above at day, but cycles into the bowels of the temple at night. There is a way, but it is not easily seen.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I have not seen anyone challenge the Anubians as you have in many a moon. Indeed, the spirit of the heroes of old lives on in you.

Title: The Secret of the Baths
Description: Thermae Alchemist Clarisse Vesta has asked you to collect Embalming Salts from the sarcophagi in Jupiter's Grove for the Roman baths in New Corsica. Deliver them to Host Habibah in the city.
Player Prompt: "Is there anything I can help with?"
Objective Proposal Response: Perhaps, if you have the capacity to exercise a certain level of discretion.
In Progress Response: The thermae in New Corsica will soon turn foul without these sands. Please hurry!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Welcome to the Thermae of New Corsica, traveler, the finest in all Aeternum.

Title: FM 16  PVP  Spy Spot  Marauder objective
FM 16  PVP  Control Spot  Marauder objective
FM 16  PVP  Control Spot  Syndicate objective

Honor's End
Description: A Roman is searching for memoriabelia of his departed friends.
Objective Proposal Response: I was once courier to the lord Crassus and his legion. He dispatched me to seek reinforcements during his battle to secure this once-sacred place.
In Progress Response: I implore you, stranger… help me perform this last act of service.
Destination Completion Available Respons: My thanks, friend. Over time, hope rots and poisons the heart. At least this way, the loved ones of our fallen can have closure.

Title: A Warm Medleyfaire Welcome
Description: Welcome to Summer Medleyfaire! Interact with the Summer Deposit Boxes and collect the instruments placed around the Summer Village.
Objective Proposal Response: Tsk, such flattery! We're going to be fast friends, you and I. But where are my manners?
In Progress Response: Come one, come all, to the Summer Medleyfaire! Ah, dear friend, are you still without an instrument? Don't be shy, select any you wish!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Yes, now you're ready to revel! I've always loved music, but the magic of the island breathes fresh life into my tunes.

Title: Maudlinbug Haze
Description: Travel to a Maudlinbug Swarmand perform the Maudlinbug Haze with a guitar equipped to collect Maudlinbug Bait and Maudlindust.
Objective Proposal Response: Why, I devised it! I thought it fitting for the little, glittery creatures.

Description: Desperate for a way to banish the cruel voice in your head, follow the rambling musings of the old hermit Yonas by seeking the wisdom of old stone carvings.

In Progress Response: Words immortalized in stone. It helps trap the ghosts… Ghosts of remembering.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="litearmor_tiltheadremember" />I hear my own voice, faint but in chorus with the ghosts here.

Title: Strength of a Soul
Description: To Learn more about the Soulwardens, face the Wardens' trials in the Tomb of the Old Warrior.

In Progress Response: <g id="litearmor_handshipsconsider" />You will know when you have found your resolve. <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Until then, I have nothing more to offer you.

Description: Yonas appears to have left you at the ruins, but luckily Grace O'Malley saw him pass by toward the town of Oxboro. Ask around to see if anyone has seen where he went off to.

In Progress Response: A lot can be gleaned from the locals. Especially when it comes to strangers.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I would ask you to walk softly, but the fish are already wise to me. Travel on, stranger.

Title: The Last Soulwarden
Description: Seek answers about the Soulwardens' fate within the tower Arcturus.
Objective Proposal Response: Oh? Did I abandon you, or did I just walk ahead? I walk a great deal you know, and sometimes, my memories stay behind.
In Progress Response: Arcturus. Yes, that's what it's called. Is it a safe place? I believe it was once.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />You have been to the tower then, have you? <g id="sit_headshakeno" />The ghosts of my fellow Wardens call from there, demanding that I remember.

Description: Yonas Alazar says that if you want to become a Soulwarden, you'll need a living seed from the Angry Earth. Yonas recalls a woman in the wildnerness, elusive as a shadow, that may be able to help you acquire such a thing, if you can find her.

In Progress Response: <g id="sit_shrugbrief" />Even if you do manage to track this Huntress down, have no expectations. <g id="sit_headshakeno" />She's not fond of other people, as I recall.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />You tread on what was once hallowed ground, human. Whatever your purpose coming here, it is misguided. <g id="male_wavehandDismissive" />Go back to your settlement.

Title: Return of the Child
Description: Prince Liang has been saved from his affliction, fulfilling the Soulwarden's commitment to the alliance with Ebonscale Reach. Meet with Empress Zhou atop Serenity Monastery and present her son, healed and finally returned to her.
Objective Proposal Response: Who I was before<g id="female_lookaroundConfused" /> I… changed… is hazy. I can only remember… images from when I was younger, playing at the broken ships…
In Progress Response: There are so<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> many more people in this world… than I remembered.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Glad<g id="grace_handheart" /> you're here - I'm in over me head. Managed to sneak up and listen. Seems Isabella<g id="grace_pointL" /> went north to gather her forces.

Title: Fallen Dynasty
Description: With Empress Zhou fallen to Corruption and determined to sail away from Aeternum, Prince Liang is in danger and so is the rest of the world. On Grace O'Malley's advice, gain access to the Royal Pier and the Empress's ship.
Objective Proposal Response: Then we'll need<g id="grace_smackfist" /> to move fast. The Empress is already headed for the docks, and that area's locked down tight.
In Progress Response: You have the Seals yet? You<g id="grace_dismiss" /> better hurry! The Empress is about to shove off!
Destination Completion Available Respons: Did you<g id="grace_beckon1" /> get the Seals? Not a second too soon! They're across<g id="grace_lookL" /> the water there - and I spotted the Empress giving that artifact to her captain.

Title: A Mother's Dream
Description: With access to the Royal Pier attained, Empress Zhou can now be reached and stopped from escaping Aeternum. Confront and defeat her before Ebonscale Reach falls further into Corruption.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="grace_headnodyes" />A solid plan, but I got an addendum. What<g id="grace_secret" /> say we shut down the Empress's enterprise and then me and you snag that artifact?
In Progress Response: <g id="grace_showoff" />Once more unto the beach!
Destination Completion Available Respons: I have only seen and heard<g id="female_leanforwardListenNod" /> a little of what transpired, but I fear to learn this story in full…

Title: The New Rising Sun
Description: Corrupted Empress Zhou is defeated and her tragic ambitions thwarted. In the aftermath of destruction, the Soulwarden have lost a powerful ally. But Prince Liang is safe, and Ebonscale Reach is secure from further Corruption. Debrief with your allies and plan next steps in the fight against the Tempest.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_nodMild" />Indeed. Yonas… I now<g id="female_lookDownGuilty" /> feel Yash's pain, keenly. I owe him an apology, I think.
In Progress Response: We<g id="female_bowHead" /> will speak in a moment, Warden.
Destination Completion Available Respons: I mourn<g id="male_nodMild" /> the loss of Empress Zhou. It seems she was an exemplary leader,<g id="female_explainS" /> but at least there is a path forward.

Title: The Shattered Mountain
Description: Yash Zafar's investigations into Shattered Mountain have uncovered signs that the Corrupted took an unusual interest in finding and imprisoning a specific individual. Search for this mysterious person and determine if they could be an ally in your fight against the Tempest.
Objective Proposal Response: I was<g id="male_headNodYes" /> hoping you'd say this, so I took the liberty of<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> ordering scouts to venture closer to the foot of the Shattered Mountain.
In Progress Response: I'll see<g id="male_bowShallow" /> you on the road to Shattered Mountain.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />I did not expect friendly welcome nor Corruption beaten back, but you<g id="male_clasphandsGrateful" /> and your fellow Soulwardens have accomplished much.

Title: Through a Mirror Darkly
Description: Father Russo is convinced from your account that a spark of goodness still exists within the Tempest. Gather relics saturated with her past emotions from the time before she fell to Corruption.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_covermouthShocked" />Oh...? Good<g id="male_handheart" /> Lord… that's the answer! If we can access her thoughts, we can rouse the emotions she tries to suppress!
In Progress Response: Go quickly.<g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" /> Isabella is on the verge of eternal damnation - and dragging the rest of the world with her.
Destination Completion Available Respons: You have done<g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" /> well. These objects harbor<g id="female_explainS" /> powerful echoes from Isabella's past,<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> when she still had some trace of innocence.

Title: Wisdom and Madness and Folly
Description: With the collection of the relics, Father Russo wishes to psychically attack the Tempest with her own memories and feelings. Join him atop the nearby vista in view of the Tempest's stronghold, and strike back at her with all of your power.
Player Prompt: "I've blocked her out of my mind."
Objective Proposal Response: Oh…<g id="male_lookaroundStartled01" /> but of course you have. Still, if you're the one who erected these mental barriers,<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> you can surely lower them as well.
In Progress Response: She may try to resist, but you alone can<g id="male_handheart" /> reach that goodness which remains. I believe in you, Soulwarden.
Destination Completion Available Respons: The prisoner seems to have captured<g id="male_laugh" /> all your attention since you arrived.<g id="female_youknowS" /> Does he have insights related to our strategy here?

Title: Marched Across the Land
Description: Now that Isabella has been wounded and frightened, it is time to secure enough allies that can overcome the defenses of Myrkgard. Yash Zafar has heard rumors that Morgaine is in trouble; search Edengrove and bring her back to the safety of the Soulwarden encampment.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="male_nodUnderstand" />Agreed.<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" /> Sun Fuchun promised she would send aid from Ebonscale, but I also hoped we could re-enlist the Sorceress Morgaine.
In Progress Response: It worries<g id="male_lookaroundWorried" /> me - the Corrupted are aware of our presence, but they do not attack.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Our Blighted brethren and sistren<g id="female_tiltheadRemember" /> come, but we cannot hear them. Their madness is not<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> like that of the human friend.

Title: The Harvest is Come
Description: Morgaine has returned to her senses after being helped by the Angry Earth Peacemaker. Phaeris provides a surprising opportunity for the Soulwardens to secure Blighted forces in the upcoming battle against the Tempest. Create a connection between Phaeris and the Blighted Angry Earth so they can communicate.
Objective Proposal Response: We cannot ask Blighted to fight with you,<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> because we cannot hear their song…<g id="female_lookdownSorry" /> here, in this place, my song is alone.
In Progress Response: Yes, speak to the human friend. She is tired from travels... but her<g id="female_headnodding" /> wisdom can aid us, aid the Blighted sistren and brethren.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />I cannot believe I'm saying this, but<g id="male_crossarmsJudge" /> it's actually a relief to be back in human society. No offense to Phaeris, she's quite nice.

Title: Angel That Brings Death
Description: Morgaine is concerned that even with Blighted Angry Earth on their side, the Soulwardens remain at a strategic disadvantage. After being reminded of her ability in Weaver's Fen to command the Lost, she will attempt to exert her will over the Ancient Guardians in the nearby cavern to further bolster your forces.
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_explainS" />The city on the mountain is called Myrkgard, as imposing as it is well-protected. It<g id="female_notsure" /> will take some army to breach its defenses.
In Progress Response: <g id="female_youknowS" />I have mixed feelings, Soulwarden. If this works, there's an<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> outstanding wager I'll owe my brother.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="female_bowDeep" />Greetings, Soulwarden. On behalf of Emperor-in-Waiting Zhou Liang,<g id="male_nodMild" /> I have come to offer the Dynasty's assistance to your cause.

Title: As Black as Sackcloth
Description: At the behest of Emperor-in-Waiting Zhou Liang, Sun Fuchun has come to Shattered Mountain to offer support. She requires a special ingredient to concoct war-grade smoke bombs that will both distract the Corrupted and prevent reinforcements from flanking the Soulwardens during the imminent assault on Myrkgard.
Objective Proposal Response: Good, because I<g id="female_nodding" /> need someone I can depend on.<g id="female_explainS" /> I've got a plan, but I could use some help.
In Progress Response: Normally,<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> I'd feel a bit overwhelmed being in such a dark place. Yet, I feel oddly exhilarated and in control.
Destination Completion Available Respons: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />You are a busy and respected person, I've come to realize.<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> Fortunately, that makes you easier to find… as long as one moves fast!

Title: To Prepare a Place For You
Description: After much research, Father Russo has discovered what he believes is the means to achieve the Tempest's defeat and salvation. Search the depths of Illurmin Canyon for two Ancient Artifacts that he requires to craft a powerful spiritual weapon.
Player Prompt: "… is there some meaning in that?"
Objective Proposal Response: <g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Don't you see? I've found what we need! Deep<g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> in the pits of this scarred canyon are Ancient objects of immense spiritual power.
In Progress Response: The end is coming. And our fates…<g id="male_lookUp" /> the world's fate... will be decided.
Destination Completion Available Respons: Remarkable.<g id="male_think" /> These artifacts are exactly what we needed. I feel as if<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> I have awoken from a nightmare<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> to bask in the morning sun.

Title: A Time For Peace, A Time for War
Description: On the eve of battle, the mood in the Soulwarden War Camp is grim. While Father Russo works to fashion his ultimate weapon, walk the camp and bolster the morale of your many allies.
Player Prompt: "Let's put your plan to the test."
Objective Proposal Response: And so<g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" /> the ending does finally begin, the conclusion of a long saga that brought us to these shores.
In Progress Response: Your pardon.<g id="male_apologizeSmall" /> These final steps will take the whole of my concentration. We will speak again shortly.
Destination Completion Available Respons: It<g id="male_spreadhands" /> is done. A masterwork, had I the luxury of the sin of pride. For your<g id="female_giveitem" /> Azoth Staff - a means to achieve Isabella's redemption.

Title: Walls Came Tumbling Down
Description: The time has come to strike at the heart of Corruption. As the vanguard of the Soulwardens and their newfound allies, assault Myrkgard and overthrow the Tempest's dominion.
Objective Proposal Response: I<g id="male_shakehead" /> do not know if one can ever be prepared for something<g id="male_guiltyLookdown" /> like this. Facing such darkness is beyond mortal comprehension.<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> But…
In Progress Response: <g id="male_bowDeepHandsfolded" />I will follow wherever you lead, Soulwarden, and say a prayer for the souls of us all.

Title: Prodigal Daughter
Description: The Tempest has been backed into a corner and has nowhere to retreat now except for within herself. Before she is able to open more Corruption Portals throughout Aeternum, use Father Russo's weapon to enter her mind and face her in combat for the last time.
Objective Proposal Response: That<g id="male_gestureLeft" /> is how I found her… secure within the depths of her own mind,<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> commanding Corruption by thought alone.
In Progress Response: "If<g id="male_lookDown" /> I shall go and prepare a place for you,<g id="male_headShakeNo" />	I will come again and will take you to myself: that<g id="male_wipetear" /> where I am, you also may be."
